Authors: Geoffroy Keime, Nicolas Cuperlier, Benoit R. Cottereau

RecMorph: Topology-Guided Spatial Recurrence for Generalized Morphology Control Locomotion

generalized morphology control spatial recurrence kinematic tree traversal cross-limb communication quadruped

简要说明：RecMorph 提出了一种拓扑引导的空间循环架构，用于机器人广义形态控制，通过对运动学树的深度优先遍历进行循环序列计算，实现高效、有效的跨肢体通信，并在 UNIMAL 基准和 Go1/Go2 等物理四足平台上得到验证。

TLDR: RecMorph introduces a topology-guided spatial recurrent architecture for generalized morphology control in robots, using recurrent sequence computation across a depth-first traversal of the kinematic tree to achieve efficient and effective cross-limb communication, demonstrated on UNIMAL benchmarks and physical quadruped platforms like Go1/Go2.

Abstract: Generalized morphology control requires a single policy to transform information across limbs with different physical roles, coordinate whole-body motion, and remain efficient as body size grows. Existing communication mechanisms address these requirements only partially. We introduce RecMorph, a topology-guided spatial recurrent architecture that uses recurrent sequence computation to jointly perform cross-limb communication and representation transformation. A depth-first traversal converts the kinematic tree into a morphology-derived sequence, along which shared bidirectional transitions progressively transform limb information before action decoding. Residual preservation, RMS normalization, and input-dependent channel modulation stabilize this repeated spatial transformation, yielding linear token complexity at fixed model width and depth. Across five UNIMAL tasks, RecMorph achieves the strongest mean final training performance among the evaluated generalized morphology controllers and the highest measured inference throughput on FT, while generalizing to unseen variations and bodies with up to 30 limbs. We further migrate representative generalized controllers from UNIMAL benchmarks to a four-platform quadruped setting. RecMorph achieves the best macro-averaged performance under nominal and high friction, reduces nominal velocity RMSE by 43.5% relative to specialist MLPs, and one shared policy completes 40 physical Go1/Go2 trials without falls. These results show that topology-guided recurrent transformation provides an effective and efficient communication mechanism for Generalized Morphology Control and remains effective when transferred from procedural bodies to physical robot platforms. Code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/quanruirao/RecMorph.

摘要（中文）：广义形态控制需要一种统一的策略，能够在具有不同物理功能的肢体间传递信息、协调全身运动，并在体型增大时保持高效性。现有通信机制仅能部分满足这些需求。我们提出了RecMorph，一种拓扑引导的空间循环架构，利用循环序列计算联合完成跨肢体通信与表示转换。通过深度优先遍历将运动学树转换为源于形态的序列，沿该序列共享的双向转换在动作解码前逐步转换肢体信息。残差保持、RMS归一化以及依赖输入的信道调制稳定了这种重复的空间转换，在固定模型宽度和深度下实现了线性令牌复杂度。在五个UNIMAL任务中，RecMorph在评估的广义形态控制器中取得了最强的平均最终训练性能，在FT任务上实现了最高的实测推理吞吐量，同时能够泛化到未见变体和多达30个肢体的身体结构。我们进一步将代表性广义控制器从UNIMAL基准迁移到四平台四足机器人场景。RecMorph在标称和高摩擦条件下均取得了最佳的宏平均性能，相较于专用MLP将标称速度RMSE降低了43.5%，且单一共享策略在40次实体Go1/Go2试验中无一摔倒。这些结果表明，拓扑引导的循环转换为广义形态控制提供了一种有效且高效的通信机制，并且在从程序化身体迁移到物理机器人平台时依然保持有效性。代码和实验资源公开于https://github.com/quanruirao/RecMorph。

Authors: Quanrui Rao, Yong Liu, Xueming Xiao, Yingbo Luo, Kun Wu, Zhenyu Xu, Meibao Yao

UAVs Meet Embodied Intelligence: Bridging Human Intents and Flying Dynamics Via Harnessing Physical-Digital AI Agents Other

UAV embodied intelligence world models vision-language navigation embodied manipulation AI agents

简要说明：本文提出了无人机具身智能的5+5统一框架，系统综述了感知、世界模型、规划、视觉语言导航、操作与协作等进展，并主张物理-数字AI智能体是实现自适应自主的系统级路径。

TLDR: This paper proposes a unified framework (5+5) for UAV embodied intelligence, reviewing recent progress in perception, world models, planning, VLN, manipulation, and collaboration, and argues for physical-digital AI agents as a pathway toward adaptive autonomy.

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) extend embodied intelligence into continuous three-dimensional space, where perception, reasoning, physical embodiment, and action are tightly coupled through flight and environmental interaction. Recent advances in foundation models, world models, and AI agents are shifting UAV autonomy from task-specific perception and control toward systems that can interpret human intent, understand open environments, reason about physical consequences, and organize complex behaviors under embodiment and flight-dynamic constraints. We characterize this emerging paradigm as UAV embodied intelligence (UAV EI) and distinguish it from its system realization, the embodied-intelligent UAV (EI UAV). To provide a unified view of the field, we introduce a 5+5 framework that describes UAV EI through five capability dimensions and EI UAVs through five architectural layers spanning physical embodiment, general cognition, embodied skills, external interaction, and system harnessing. Based on this framework, we systematically review recent progress in embodied morphology, embodied perception, world models, embodied planning, vision-language navigation, embodied manipulation, and embodied collaboration. We further identify long-horizon autonomy, predictive physical reasoning, test-time skill acquisition, and autonomous capability evolution as key challenges toward more general aerial embodied intelligence. Finally, we argue that harnessing physical-digital AI agents, through persistent coupling of digital intelligence with physical sensing, dynamics, action, and feedback, provides a system-level pathway toward adaptive and continuously evolving UAV autonomy. Project resources are available at our project website and GitHub repository.

摘要（中文）：无人机将具身智能拓展至连续三维空间，在此空间中，感知、推理、物理实体与行动通过飞行及环境交互紧密耦合。近年来，基础模型、世界模型及人工智能体（AI智能体）的进展，正推动无人机自主性从面向特定任务的感知与控制，向能够理解人类意图、感知开放环境、推理物理后果，并在具身与飞行动力学约束下组织复杂行为的系统演进。我们将这一新兴范式定义为无人机具身智能（UAV EI），并将其与系统实现形式——具身智能无人机（EI UAV）相区分。为形成对该领域的统一视角，我们提出一个“5+5”框架，分别从五个能力维度描述无人机具身智能，以及从五个架构层级刻画具身智能无人机，涵盖物理实体、通用认知、具身技能、外部交互与系统驾驭。基于该框架，我们系统综述了近年来在具身形态、具身感知、世界模型、具身规划、视觉-语言导航、具身操作与具身协作方面的研究进展。进一步，我们将长期自主性、预测性物理推理、测试时技能获取及自主能力演进，识别为实现更通用空中具身智能所面临的关键挑战。最后，我们认为，通过将数字智能与物理感知、动力学、行动与反馈持续耦合，驾驭物理-数字人工智能体，为实现自适应且持续演进的无人机自主性提供了一条系统级路径。项目资源可在我们的项目网站及GitHub仓库中获取。

Authors: Yonglin Tian, Weiyi Wang, Houhua Lu, Xinyi Li, Yihao Wu, Jingyang Chen, Jianli Sun, Chengxiang Li, Yinuo Chen, Fei Lin, Tengchao Zhang, Jing Yang, Deyi Ji, Jian Di, Naiqi Wu, Yisheng Lv

RAFAIL: Relationship-Aware Failure Detection for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

failure detection OOD detection relationship-aware vision-language models point-cloud representations

简要说明：RAFAIL 是一个用于机器人操作中执行失败检测的框架，通过对任务相关实体间关系进行 OOD 检测来识别失败，利用 VLM 离线标注的学习表示，并在运行时无需 VLM 推理。在三个真实世界任务上达到 73.4% 的平衡准确率，且无需失败数据。

TLDR: RAFAIL is a framework for detecting execution failures in robotic manipulation by using OOD detection on task-relevant relationships between entities, learned offline via VLM-annotated demonstrations and operating without runtime VLM inference. It achieves 73.4% balanced accuracy on three real-world tasks, outperforming baselines without requiring failure data.

Abstract: Detecting failures during execution is essential for reliable robotic manipulation. Vision-language models (VLMs) can assess task outcomes semantically but add runtime computation, whereas out-of-distribution (OOD) detectors may respond to harmless scene variations rather than failure-relevant deviations. We introduce RAFAIL, a framework for detecting execution failures during robotic manipulation. RAFAIL identifies failures by detecting anomalies in task-relevant relationships between entities, such as a gripper and an object or an object and its target. By focusing OOD detection on relevant parts of the observation, RAFAIL reduces sensitivity to task-irrelevant scene variation. Offline, a VLM annotates successful demonstrations with task progress and relationship importance, which are used to learn point-cloud-based relationship representations without relying on policy-internal features. At runtime, relationship-specific OOD detectors evaluate these representations while relationship importance and task progress are predicted without VLM inference. RAFAIL requires no failure data and achieves 73.4% balanced accuracy across three real-world robotic manipulation tasks, outperforming the strongest evaluated OOD- and uncertainty-based baselines.

摘要（中文）：在执行过程中检测故障对于可靠的机器人操作至关重要。视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够从语义层面评估任务结果，但会增加运行时计算负担；而分布外（OOD）检测器则可能对无关的场景变化做出响应，而非与故障相关的偏差。我们提出了RAFAIL框架，用于在机器人操作过程中检测执行故障。RAFAIL通过检测实体之间任务相关关系中的异常来识别故障，例如夹爪与物体之间或物体与其目标之间的关系。通过将OOD检测聚焦于观测中的相关部分，RAFAIL降低了对任务无关场景变化的敏感性。在离线阶段，VLM为成功演示标注任务进度和关系重要性，用于学习基于点云的关系表示，而无需依赖策略内部特征。在运行时，关系特定的OOD检测器评估这些表示，同时在不进行VLM推理的情况下预测关系重要性和任务进度。RAFAIL不需要故障数据，在三个真实世界机器人操作任务中实现了73.4%的平衡准确率，优于所评估的最强OOD基线和基于不确定性的基线方法。

Authors: Loris Schneider, Edgar Welte, Rania Rayyes

WAVE-Go: World-Model Navigation with Adaptive Execution for Wheel-Legged Robots Locomotion

world model image-goal navigation wheel-legged robot adaptive execution conditional risk

简要说明：WAVE-Go 提出了一种基于世界模型的轮腿机器人图像目标导航框架，将预测与可中断执行分离，通过自适应选择动作前缀和取消待执行命令，在动态障碍下提升成功率并减少碰撞。

TLDR: WAVE-Go introduces a world-model-based image-goal navigation framework for wheel-legged robots that separates prediction from interruptible execution, adaptively selecting action prefixes and canceling pending commands to improve success and reduce collisions under dynamic obstacles.

Abstract: World models can anticipate the consequences of navigation actions, but predicted action sequences may become invalid during execution, especially when wheel-legged robots encounter dynamic obstacles or change locomotion modes. We propose WAVE-Go, an image-goal navigation framework that separates world-action prediction from interruptible command execution. Its executor adaptively selects an action prefix and cancels pending commands when updated observations invalidate execution. A conditional-risk formulation specifies prefix selection under an estimated cumulative failure budget, while posture and locomotion-mode transitions require clearance, stability, and task-evidence checks. In the reported navigation evaluation, WAVE-Go achieves 74.1% in-distribution success and 63.3% dynamic out-of-distribution success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.7 and 7.7 percentage points, respectively, while reducing collisions from 4.4 to 2.9 per 100 m. Compared with interruptible fixed four-command execution, WAVE-Go raises success by 4.0 percentage points while reducing replanning frequency by 51.2% and collision rate by 6.5%. Execution ablations also show that runtime interruption improves success, collision rate, and reaction latency at the cost of additional replanning. These results support adaptive, interruptible execution as a means of balancing navigation performance and planning overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/vigorlee/wave-go.

摘要（中文）：世界模型能够预测导航行为的后果，但在执行过程中，预测的动作序列可能会失效，尤其是当轮腿机器人遇到动态障碍物或切换运动模式时。我们提出WAVE-Go，一种图像目标导航框架，将世界动作预测与可中断的命令执行分离。其执行器自适应地选择动作前缀，并在更新后的观测使执行失效时取消待处理命令。条件风险公式在估计的累积失败预算下指定前缀选择，而姿态和运动模式切换需要间隙、稳定性和任务证据检查。在报告的导航评估中，WAVE-Go实现了74.1%的分布内成功率和63.3%的动态分布外成功率，分别超过最强基线4.7和7.7个百分点，同时将碰撞率从每100米4.4次降低到2.9次。与可中断的固定四命令执行相比，WAVE-Go将成功率提高了4.0个百分点，同时将重规划频率降低了51.2%，碰撞率降低了6.5%。执行消融实验还表明，运行时中断提高了成功率、碰撞率和反应延迟，但以增加重规划为代价。这些结果支持自适应、可中断执行作为平衡导航性能和规划开销的一种手段。代码可在https://github.com/vigorlee/wave-go获取。

Authors: Mingyi Li, Ji Li, Zhihao Ouyang, Yage He, Börje F. Karlsson

OmniRisk: Omnidirectional Trajectory-Risk Learning for Agile Quadrotor Dynamic Avoidance RLRobot

agile quadrotor trajectory-risk learning dynamic avoidance circular convolutional network onnibearing planning

简要说明：OmniRisk 提出了一种用于敏捷四旋翼的全向规划框架，通过双分支圆形卷积网络离线学习轨迹级风险，实现在机高效规避快速移动障碍物，并在高达 15 米/秒的相对遭遇速度下完成真实世界飞行验证。

TLDR: OmniRisk presents an omnidirectional planning framework for agile quadrotors that learns trajectory-level risk offline via a dual-branch circular convolutional network, enabling efficient onboard avoidance of fast-moving obstacles with real-world flights at up to 15 m/s.

Abstract: Agile quadrotor avoidance of fast-moving obstacles requires anticipating collisions and selecting feasible maneuvers within short reaction windows. Reliable predictive avoidance remains challenging because sparse range observations do not directly reveal obstacle motion, while online trajectory optimizers either scale poorly with obstacle count or remain efficient at the expense of reliability in dense, high-speed encounters. We present OmniRisk, an omnidirectional planning framework that learns trajectory-level risk offline for efficient onboard evasion. A fixed-dimensional tensor combines LiDAR range panoramas, dynamic masks, and Cartesian surface velocities to represent geometry and motion jointly. We formulate an asymmetric risk field aligned with obstacle velocity that emphasizes approaching interactions and attenuates receding ones. Accumulating this risk along predicted relative trajectories provides dense supervision and discourages unnecessary hesitation after obstacles pass. A dual-branch circular convolutional network predicts terminal boundary states and dynamic risks for candidate primitives over an omnidirectional anchor lattice in a single forward pass, followed by selection and closed-form reconstruction of the selected candidate primitive. This formulation removes online risk accumulation along trajectories and makes risk-inference cost independent of obstacle count. OmniRisk enables efficient onboard avoidance, with real-world flights demonstrating consecutive evasive maneuvers at relative encounter speeds up to 15 m/s without fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/VANdexj/OmniRisk.

摘要（中文）：敏捷四旋翼飞行器规避快速移动障碍物时，需要预测碰撞并在极短的反应窗口内选择可行机动策略。可靠的预测性规避仍具挑战性，因为稀疏的距离观测无法直接揭示障碍物运动，而在线轨迹优化器要么随障碍物数量增加而扩展性变差，要么以牺牲可靠性为代价在密集、高速遭遇场景中保持高效。我们提出OmniRisk，一种全向规划框架，通过离线学习轨迹级风险来实现高效的机载规避。固定维度张量融合激光雷达距离全景、动态掩膜和笛卡尔表面速度，共同表示几何与运动信息。我们构建了与障碍物速度对齐的非对称风险场，强调接近中的交互并衰减远离中的交互。沿预测相对轨迹累积该风险可提供密集监督，并抑制障碍物通过后的不必要犹豫。双分支环形卷积网络在单次前向传播中，在全向锚点格上预测候选基元的终端边界状态和动态风险，随后进行候选基元的选择与闭式重构。该公式消除了沿轨迹的在线风险累积，使风险推断成本与障碍物数量无关。OmniRisk实现了高效的机载规避，实际飞行测试展示了在相对遭遇速度高达15米/秒的情况下连续执行规避机动，且无需微调。代码见https://github.com/VANdexj/OmniRisk。

Authors: Yifan He, Yang Liu, Wenhao Zhao, Hai Lin, Deping Zhang, Mingze Ma, Fei Gao, Huan Yu, Zipeng Dai, Ziming Ding

Characterizing Replay Retention Under Dynamics Shift in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

model-based RL dynamics shift replay retention continual learning locomotion

简要说明：本文研究在机器人动力学变化下的持续模型强化学习中，重放旧数据何时有益或有害，提出基于变化幅度和年龄-陈旧性AUC的特征描述，并在多种运动形态和真实世界基准上进行了实验。

TLDR: This paper studies when replaying old data helps or hurts in continual model-based RL under robot dynamics shifts, proposing a characterization based on change magnitude and age-staleness AUC, with experiments on locomotion morphologies and real-world benchmarks.

Abstract: Adapting to changes in robot dynamics requires learning from new data without discarding experience that may still be useful. In continual model-based reinforcement learning (RL), replay collected before a dynamics change can slow adaptation, while removing it unnecessarily reduces available training data and can be especially costly if earlier dynamics return. We study when recent transitions are preferable to the full replay history. Two quantities characterize this trade-off: change magnitude and age-staleness area under the curve (AUC), measuring how well transition age separates stale from fresh data. Forgetting stale data helps after large permanent shifts but hurts when dynamics recur and older data becomes useful again. Choosing a replay strategy therefore depends on predicting when older data will help or hurt. We test these effects across two locomotion morphologies, two model-based RL algorithms, and Real-World RL benchmark perturbations. Because ground-truth staleness labels are unavailable on deployed robots, we evaluate whether an estimator built from interaction data can still provide the quantities needed to choose a replay strategy after permanent changes. Our results show that replay retention depends on change magnitude and on how the dynamics evolve.

摘要（中文）：适应机器人动力学的变化需要从新数据中学习，同时不能丢弃可能仍有价值的过往经验。在持续基于模型的强化学习（RL）中，在动力学变化之前收集的回放数据可能减缓适应性调整，而将其完全移除则不必要地减少了可用训练数据，且若早期动力学再次出现，这种损失可能尤为严重。我们研究了在何种情况下近期转换优于完整的回放历史。两个量刻画了这一权衡：变化幅度以及年龄-陈旧性曲线下面积（AUC），后者衡量转换年龄在多大程度上区分陈旧数据与新鲜数据。遗忘陈旧数据有助于大幅永久性变化后的适应，但在动力学重复出现且较旧数据重新变得有用时则会产生不利影响。因此，选择回放策略取决于预测较旧数据何时会有帮助或产生阻碍。我们在两种运动形态、两种基于模型的强化学习算法以及Real-World RL基准扰动上测试了这些效应。由于在实际部署的机器人上无法获得真实陈旧性标签，我们评估了基于交互数据构建的估计器是否仍能提供在永久性变化后选择回放策略所需的量。我们的结果表明，回放保留取决于变化幅度以及动力学的演化方式。

Authors: Everest Yang, Skye Thompson, George D. Konidaris

LUMO: Designing Luminous Contact Morphology for Repeatable Whole-Finger Contact Observation Manipulation

contact morphology optical sensing force estimation Bayesian optimization robot finger

简要说明：LUMO 优化了具有嵌入式 LED 的柔性机器人手指的横截面，使接触位置可通过侧面发射的光模式被外部观察，从而结合关节力矩提高法向力估计精度。

TLDR: LUMO optimizes the cross-section of a compliant robot finger with embedded LEDs so that contact location becomes observable from side-emitted light patterns, enabling force estimation from joint torque with improved accuracy.

Abstract: A low-impedance robot finger reports through joint torque how strongly it is loaded, but the same torque can arise from a small force near the fingertip or a large force near the joint. Resolving the force therefore requires knowing where along the finger contact occurred. LUMO makes that location externally observable. Embedded LEDs illuminate a compliant silicone pad, and contact deforms the pad so that light emerging from the finger's side changes in a pattern set by where the load acts. Because the same structure also carries the contact load, we optimize its cross-section, including the pad profile, rigid carrier, and lateral void, for two behaviors at once. Mechanically, the pad conforms under low preload while the carrier increasingly restricts further deformation as load rises. Optically, different contact locations produce separated responses on the finger's side. The search uses rigid--soft contact simulation, ray tracing, and multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across two silicones, six contact locations, and 10- and 30-mm spherical indenters, the optimized morphologies improve neighboring-location separation relative to variation from re-establishing contact by \(15\)--\(59\%\). Estimating contact location from the optical response using the known LED spacing and combining it with joint torque gives \(1.44~\mathrm{N}\) normal-force MAE over 931 samples. In a two-finger hand, localized side responses appear on several links simultaneously during grasps.

摘要（中文）：低阻抗机器人手指通过关节扭矩报告其所承受的负载大小，但相同的扭矩可能源于指尖附近的小力或关节附近的大力。因此，要解算力的大小，必须知道接触发生在手指的哪个位置。LUMO使该位置在外部可观测。嵌入的LED照亮柔性硅胶垫，接触使垫发生变形，从而从手指侧面射出的光线模式随负载作用位置而改变。由于同一结构也承受接触负载，我们对其横截面（包括垫轮廓、刚性载体和侧向空隙）进行优化，以同时实现两种性能。在力学方面，垫在低预载下顺应变形，而随着负载增加，载体逐渐限制进一步变形；在光学方面，不同接触位置在手指侧面产生分离的响应模式。该搜索采用刚-柔接触仿真、光线追踪和多目标贝叶斯优化。在两种硅胶、六个接触位置以及10毫米和30毫米球形压头条件下，优化后的形态将使相邻位置分离度相对于重新接触所造成的变异提升15\%--59\%。利用已知LED间距从光学响应估计接触位置，并将其与关节扭矩结合，在931个样本上法向力平均绝对误差为1.44牛顿。在双指手中，抓取过程中多个连杆上同时出现局部侧面响应。

Authors: Dong Ho Kang, Youngsu Ko, Luis Sentis

Energy-Regularized Imitation Learning for Force- and Work-Aware Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

imitation learning energy regularization force-aware manipulation mechanical work RLBench

简要说明：本文提出一种能量正则化模仿学习方法，利用可微能量预测器减少机器人操作中的机械功，在RLBench任务上使用RVT-2展示了任务成功率和能量效率的小幅提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes an energy-regularized imitation learning method that uses a differentiable energy predictor to reduce mechanical work in robotic manipulation, demonstrating small improvements in task success and energy efficiency across RLBench tasks with RVT-2.

Abstract: This paper studies energy-aware manipulation as a physically grounded learning problem. We define a joint-space mechanical-work proxy from joint torque and angular displacement, and train a differentiable energy predictor that estimates this work from robot states and actions. The predictor converts a non-differentiable simulator-side physical quantity into a differentiable regularizer for fine-tuning a pretrained manipulation policy. We instantiate the framework with RVT-2 on RLBench and evaluate 12 manipulation tasks involving object contact, articulated motion, placement, pushing, and sweeping. The proposed fine-tuning reduces the average mechanical work from 208.8J to 204.4J (i.e., 2.1% reduction), while the mean task success rate also increases slightly from 86.2% to 86.9%. These results show that work-aware policy optimization can suppress physically inefficient motion without requiring an explicit differentiable dynamics model.

摘要（中文）：本文研究能量感知操作作为一个基于物理的学习问题。我们根据关节力矩和角位移定义了关节空间机械功代理量，并训练了一个可微分的能量预测器，用于从机器人状态和动作估计该功。该预测器将仿真器侧不可微分的物理量转化为可微分的正则项，用于对预训练操作策略进行微调。我们在RLBench上以RVT-2为基础实现了该框架，并评估了涉及物体接触、关节运动、放置、推和扫等12项操作任务。所提出的微调方法将平均机械功从208.8J降至204.4J（即降低2.1%），同时平均任务成功率也从86.2%略微提升至86.9%。结果表明，功感知策略优化能够在无需显式可微分动力学模型的情况下抑制物理上低效的运动。

Authors: Toshiki Otani, Hiromu Taketsugu, Norimichi Ukita

Prior Evolution and Task Alignment for Aerial Grasping Manipulation

aerial grasping trajectory optimization CEM Execution-Aware Critic learning for planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于空中抓取的学习增强轨迹优化框架，通过CEM演化学习先验，并利用执行感知评论器提供可微抓取代价，以提高优化可靠性和抓取成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a learning-augmented trajectory optimization framework for aerial grasping, where a learned prior is evolved via CEM and an Execution-Aware Critic provides a differentiable grasping cost to improve optimization reliability and grasp success.

Abstract: Aerial grasping is a remarkable capability exhibited by predatory birds, allowing them to capture prey through highly coordinated maneuvers in flight. Inspired by this capability, researchers have developed various formulations to reproduce such maneuvers through trajectory optimization. However, two limitations remain in practice. First, the resulting optimization problem is highly nonconvex and sensitive to initialization, making high-quality solutions difficult to obtain under a limited computational budget. Second, prescribed numerical objectives are human-designed abstractions that describe successful grasping through a limited set of mathematically tractable quantities and may not fully capture what determines task success. We investigate how learning can address these limitations within an analytical planner. Accordingly, a trajectory prior is first learned from optimized motions and then evolved through a CEM-based process that evaluates sampled initializations with the deployed optimizer and retains favorable ones as new supervision. An Execution-Aware Critic learns from contact, lift, and completion outcomes to assess whether the optimized trajectories are likely to succeed in physical execution. Its frozen energy can further serve as a differentiable grasping cost, allowing execution data to directly shape trajectory generation. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved optimization reliability, trajectory consistency, and grasping performance.

摘要（中文）：空中抓取是捕食性鸟类展现的一项卓越能力，使它们能够通过飞行中的高度协调动作捕获猎物。受此能力启发，研究人员已开发出多种公式，通过轨迹优化来再现此类动作。然而，实际应用中仍存在两个局限。首先，由此产生的优化问题高度非凸且对初始化敏感，导致在有限的计算预算下难以获得高质量解。其次，预设的数值目标是人为设计的抽象概念，通过有限的一组数学上可处理的量来描述成功抓取，可能无法完全捕捉决定任务成败的关键因素。我们研究了学习如何在分析型规划器框架内解决这些局限。据此，首先从优化后的运动中学习一个轨迹先验，然后通过基于CEM的流程对其进行演化，该流程使用部署的优化器评估采样的初始化，并保留那些表现优异的初始化作为新的监督信号。一个执行感知评论家网络从接触、提升和完成结果中学习，以评估优化后的轨迹在物理执行中成功的可能性。其冻结的能量函数还可作为可微分的抓取代价，使执行数据能够直接影响轨迹生成。仿真和实机实验证明了优化可靠性、轨迹一致性及抓取性能均得到提升。

Authors: Weiliang Deng, Zhengyang Dang, Yao Mu, Ximin Lyu

"Your Robot Was Trained on a Lie": Collision Mesh Poisoning Attacks on Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

robotic manipulation collision mesh poisoning sim-to-real gap 3D asset supply chain adversarial attack

简要说明：本文提出了一种名为碰撞网格投毒（CMP）的新型攻击，仅修改机器人模拟器中3D资产的碰撞网格，导致基于其训练的策略在现实世界中失效或产生安全隐患，并证明现有防御措施不足以抵御此类攻击。

TLDR: This paper introduces Collision Mesh Poisoning (CMP), a novel attack that modifies only the collision mesh of 3D assets in robot simulators, causing policies trained with them to fail or become unsafe in the real world, and demonstrates that current defenses are insufficient.

Abstract: Learning-enabled robotic manipulation increasingly relies on robot simulators for policy training and evaluation before real-world deployment. Inside a simulator, a 3D asset contains two separate geometries: a visual mesh used for rendering and a collision mesh used for physical interaction. For computational efficiency, the collision mesh is deliberately a coarse approximation that need not have the same geometry as the visual mesh, a legitimate and pervasive discrepancy we call the Visual--Collision Gap (V--C Gap). We show that the V--C Gap opens a new and practical attack surface, and propose Collision Mesh Poisoning (CMP), the first poisoning attack against robotic manipulation delivered through the 3D asset supply chain. An attacker modifies only the collision mesh of a 3D asset, leaving the visual mesh and all other components unchanged. A policy trained and evaluated with the poisoned asset behaves normally throughout simulation, yet degrades, fails, or creates physical safety risks once deployed in the real world. Since current asset review practices cover malware, copyright, and format compliance, but not visual--collision consistency, poisoned assets can be distributed through legitimate supply chain channels. We evaluate several defenses and our results show that they are insufficient to defend against CMP, highlighting the need for new defenses.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的功能型机器人操作技术，在部署到现实世界前，越来越依赖于机器人模拟器进行策略训练与评估。在模拟器中，每个三维资产包含两个独立的几何体：用于渲染的视觉网格和用于物理交互的碰撞网格。为追求计算效率，碰撞网格常被刻意设计为粗略近似，无需与视觉网格几何形状一致，这种合理且普遍存在的差异，我们称之为“视觉—碰撞差距”（Visual--Collision Gap，简称V--C Gap）。研究表明，V--C Gap揭示了一个新的且实用的攻击面，并首次提出了“碰撞网格投毒”（Collision Mesh Poisoning，简称CMP）攻击，这是首个通过三维资产生成供应链针对机器人操作实施的投毒攻击。攻击者仅修改三维资产的碰撞网格，而保持视觉网格及其他所有组件不变。使用被投毒资产训练与评估的策略，在仿真过程中表现正常，但一旦部署到现实世界，则会出现性能下降、失败或引发物理安全隐患。鉴于当前资产审查实践涵盖恶意软件、版权及格式合规，但未涉及视觉—碰撞一致性，因此被投毒资产可通过合法的供应链渠道分发。针对多种防御措施的评估结果表明，现有防御手段不足以抵御CMP攻击，凸显了开发新防御措施的必要性。

Authors: Gengyang Xu, Dongwei Xiao, Yiteng Peng, Yanbo Dai, Ruochen Zhou, Shing-Chi Cheung, Xiaoyu Ji, Wenyuan Xu, Shuai Wang

Technical Report: One-Step Drifting Action Heads for GR00T N1.7 VLA

one-step action generation diffusion-transformer action head closed-loop task success LIBERO benchmark speed-success trade-off

简要说明：该技术报告将GR00T N1.7 VLA模型的迭代扩散Transformer动作头替换为单步漂移动作头，实现了显著的推理加速（动作头从45.3毫秒降至5.0毫秒），但在LIBERO上导致任务成功率系统性下降，并将结果呈现为速度与成功率之间的权衡。

TLDR: This technical report replaces the iterative diffusion-transformer action head of the GR00T N1.7 VLA model with a one-step drifting action head, achieving significant inference speedups (action head 45.3ms to 5.0ms) but with a systematic reduction in task success on LIBERO, presenting the results as a speed-success trade-off.

Abstract: One-step action generation can substantially reduce the inference cost of vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but its effect on closed-loop task success remains an open question. This technical report studies a GR00T N1.7 variant in which the iterative diffusion-transformer action head is replaced by a one-step drifting action head, together with an overlap-conditioned extension for asynchronous chunk replacement. All multi-seed drifting runs were trained on two NVIDIA A800 GPUs. On LIBERO, the action head reduces the mean model-forward time of the action head from approximately $45.3\,\mathrm{ms}$ to $5.0\,\mathrm{ms}$, while the measured backbone-plus-head time falls from approximately $70.0\,\mathrm{ms}$ to $30.6\,\mathrm{ms}$. However, this speedup is accompanied by a systematic reduction in task success. Across three drifting seeds, success is $64.0\pm4.0\%$ on LIBERO-Spatial, $52.0\pm1.0\%$ on LIBERO-Goal, and $26.0\pm2.6\%$ on LIBERO-Long. The low seed variance indicates that the degradation is not explained by random initialization alone. We report the result as a speed--success trade-off rather than an overall improvement, and discuss likely contributing factors including deterministic one-step mode averaging, batch-dependent geometry estimation, long open-loop chunk execution, and the fact that synchronous LIBERO evaluation does not exercise the asynchronous overlap path.

摘要（中文）：一步式动作生成能够大幅降低视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的推理成本，但其对闭环任务成功率的影响仍是一个悬而未决的问题。本技术报告研究了一种GR00T N1.7变体，其中将迭代扩散Transformer动作头替换为一步式漂移动作头，并引入了一种基于重叠条件的扩展以支持异步子块替换。所有多随机种子漂移实验均在两张NVIDIA A800 GPU上完成训练。在LIBERO基准上，该动作头将动作头的平均模型前向时间从约$45.3\,\mathrm{ms}$降至$5.0\,\mathrm{ms}$，而实测的骨干网络加动作头整体时间从约$70.0\,\mathrm{ms}$降至$30.6\,\mathrm{ms}$。然而，这一加速伴随着任务成功率的系统性下降。在三个漂移随机种子下，LIBERO-Spatial上的成功率为$64.0\pm4.0\%$，LIBERO-Goal上为$52.0\pm1.0\%$，LIBERO-Long上为$26.0\pm2.6\%$。较低的随机种子方差表明，性能下降不能仅由随机初始化解释。我们将该结果报告为速度-成功率之间的权衡，而非整体性能提升，并讨论了可能的促成因素，包括确定性一步模式平均、依赖批次的几何估计、长开环子块执行，以及同步LIBERO评估未涉及异步重叠路径这一事实。

Authors: Xihe Shao

Beyond Pixel Similarity: Task-Aware Evaluation of GAN-Based Synthetic Sonar Data for Robotic Perception Perception3D

synthetic sonar data GAN object detection task-aware evaluation robotic perception

简要说明：本文评估了用于机器人感知的GAN生成合成声纳数据，表明像素级保真度指标不能一致预测下游目标检测性能，并提倡对合成传感器数据进行任务感知评估。

TLDR: This paper evaluates GAN-generated synthetic sonar data for robotic perception, showing that pixel-level fidelity metrics do not consistently predict downstream object-detection performance, and advocates for task-aware evaluation of synthetic sensor data.

Abstract: Synthetic data can reduce the cost of collecting and annotating training data for robotic perception, but generating sensor observations that preserve the characteristics relevant to downstream perception remains challenging, particularly for sonar imagery. In this work, we investigate whether conventional image-fidelity metrics adequately reflect the downstream perception performance of GAN-generated synthetic sonar data. We employ a Pix2Pix conditional generative adversarial network with four discriminator configurations characterized by different receptive fields: PixelGAN, PatchGAN-16, PatchGAN-70, and ImageGAN. The models are trained using sonar imagery from two datasets and evaluated using conventional image-fidelity metrics, including Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Mean Squared Error (MSE). To complement these pixel-level measures with task-oriented evaluation, YOLOX-S, YOLOX-L, and Faster R-CNN detectors are trained exclusively on real sonar imagery and subsequently evaluated on the GAN-generated images using identical test samples and annotations across all discriminator configurations. The results reveal a discrepancy between image-fidelity and downstream object-detection performance: the configuration achieving the best SSIM, PSNR, and MSE does not consistently yield the best detection performance. In particular, PatchGAN configurations achieve strong downstream detection results despite not achieving the highest pixel-level similarity scores. These findings suggest, for the datasets and models considered, pixel-level image-fidelity metrics alone may not consistently capture the task-relevant realism of synthetic sonar observations and motivate the use of task-aware evaluation for synthetic sensor data intended for robotic perception.

摘要（中文）：合成数据能够降低机器人感知训练数据采集与标注的成本，但生成在保留与下游感知相关特征方面有效的传感器观测数据仍具挑战性，尤其是在声纳图像领域。本研究探讨了传统图像保真度指标是否足以反映生成对抗网络（GAN）生成的合成声纳数据在下游感知任务中的表现。我们采用Pix2Pix条件生成对抗网络，并配置四种具有不同感受野的判别器结构：PixelGAN、PatchGAN-16、PatchGAN-70和ImageGAN。模型使用来自两个数据集的声纳图像进行训练，并通过传统图像保真度指标进行评估，包括结构相似性指数（SSIM）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）和均方误差（MSE）。为将这些像素级度量与任务导向评估相结合，我们仅使用真实声纳图像训练YOLOX-S、YOLOX-L和Faster R-CNN检测器，随后在所有判别器配置下使用相同的测试样本和标注对GAN生成图像进行评估。结果显示图像保真度与下游目标检测性能之间存在差异：在SSIM、PSNR和MSE上表现最佳的配置并不始终对应最优检测性能。具体而言，PatchGAN配置虽未达到最高的像素级相似度得分，却取得了优异的下游检测结果。这些发现表明，对于所考虑的数据集和模型，仅依赖像素级图像保真度指标可能无法始终反映合成声纳观测数据中与任务相关的真实性，因此有必要对面向机器人感知的合成传感器数据采用任务感知型评估方法。

Authors: Hannan Ejaz Keen, Muhammad Moazam Fraz, Karsten Berns

CLASP: A Cluster-Level Autonomous Selective Picking Robot with a Soft Rolling-Band Gripper for Fresh-Market Blueberry Harvesting Manipulation

selective harvesting soft gripper cluster-level picking perception pipeline field trials

简要说明：CLASP 是一款面向鲜食蓝莓的簇级选择性采摘机器人，采用软体滚动带夹爪和全局到局部的感知流程，田间试验抓取成功率达92%，且组件成本较低。

TLDR: CLASP is a cluster-level selective harvesting robot for fresh-market blueberries, featuring a soft rolling-band gripper and a global-to-local perception pipeline, achieving 92% grasp success in field trials with low component cost.

Abstract: Fresh-market blueberries require selective, gentle picking, which is labor-intensive and expensive. Over-the-row machine harvesters are fast but non-selective, bruising mixed-ripeness fruit and limiting yield to the processing market. Selective robotic harvesters typically target individual fruits rather than fruit clusters, which limits harvesting efficiency for small, densely clustered blueberries. This paper presents CLASP, a Cluster-Level Autonomous Selective Picking robot with a Soft Active Rolling-Band Gripper (SARB-Gripper). Two compliant bands envelop the cluster and roll against the fruit, drawing mature berries off in sequence, while closed-loop regulation of the pulling force keeps the applied load below the immature detachment threshold. A global-to-local perception pipeline pairs an eye-to-hand camera for global cluster detection and target selection with an eye-in-hand camera for local localization and cluster orientation estimation. Field measurements confirm a clear detachment-force separation between mature and immature fruit, and the SARB-Gripper reproduces a commanded pulling force to within \SI{3.7}{\percent}, enabling selective harvesting at the cluster level. In end-to-end field trials, CLASP autonomously grasped 23 of 25 presented clusters (\SI{92}{\percent}). With the component cost of approximately \$3326 per unit, CLASP offers a scalable approach to selective cluster-level harvesting for fresh-market blueberries.

摘要（中文）：鲜食蓝莓需要选择性、轻柔的采摘，这一过程劳动强度大且成本高昂。跨行式机器收割机速度快，但缺乏选择性，会损伤成熟度不均的果实，且仅限于加工市场使用。选择性机器人收割机通常针对单个果实而非果簇作业，这限制了其对小而密集蓝莓果簇的采收效率。本文介绍了CLASP——一种配备软体主动滚动带夹爪的簇级自主选择性采摘机器人。两条柔性带包裹果簇并滚动接触果实，依次将成熟浆果拉下，同时通过闭环拉力调节将施加负载控制在未成熟果实脱离阈值以下。全局到局部的感知流程将眼手相机用于全局果簇检测与目标选择，同时使用眼在手相机进行局部定位与果簇朝向估计。田间测量证实成熟与未成熟果实之间存在明显的脱离力差异，且软体主动滚动带夹爪再现指定拉力的精度达到3.7%，实现了簇级选择性采收。在端到端田间试验中，CLASP自主抓取了25个果簇中的23个（92%）。以每台约3326美元的部件成本计算，CLASP为鲜食蓝莓的簇级选择性采收提供了一种可扩展的方案。

Authors: Yixuan Xia, Yilin Cai, Natalia Belen Espinoza, Changying Li, Zilfina Rubio Ames, Xin Zhang, Yue Chen

Missing Bridges: Composition-Aware Active Imitation Learning Manipulation

active imitation learning composition latent topology diffusion policy task reachability

简要说明：AALT 通过选择能最大化起始-目标连通性增益的示范，构建潜在拓扑结构以支持可组合的多任务行为，并在模拟 UR5e 检索任务中验证。

TLDR: AALT selects demonstrations that maximize expected gains in start-goal connectivity for active imitation learning, building a latent topology of hub states to enable composable multi-task behavior, demonstrated on a simulated UR5e retrieval domain.

Abstract: Active imitation learning reduces expert effort by allowing a learner to request the demonstrations it needs. Existing methods typically select these requests for their expected information gain about the expert policy. In structured multi-task domains, however, the number of start-goal tasks may grow combinatorially despite their solutions sharing reusable behavior. This makes composable behaviors especially valuable, since a single demonstration may help solve many tasks at once. Prior methods do not explicitly account for this value when selecting which demonstration to request. We introduce Adaptive Agents via Latent Topologies (AALT), which requests demonstrations that maximize expected gains in start-goal connectivity. We further show that this objective is formally tied to information gain about task reachability. AALT organizes existing demonstrations into a topology of latent hub states connected by learned behaviors, identifies high-value bridge demonstrations that are likely to enable many tasks at once, and grounds each to an expert query. At inference, it plans through the resulting topology and conditions a diffusion policy on each successive hub transition. In a simulated UR5e robot ordered-retrieval domain with 72 tasks, AALT improved from 42/72 to 72/72 (100%) successful tasks consistently using only 3 demonstrations totaling 5 transitions beyond the initial dataset. After 20 demonstrations, the strongest baseline averaged 88.6% success using 98 transitions.

摘要（中文）：主动模仿学习通过允许学习者请求所需的示范来减少专家的工作量。现有方法通常根据这些请求对专家策略的预期信息增益进行选择。然而，在结构化的多任务领域中，起始-目标任务的数量可能组合式增长，尽管它们的解决方案共享可复用的行为。这使得可组合行为尤为宝贵，因为一次示范可能同时有助于解决多个任务。先前的方法在选择请求哪些示范时并未明确考虑这一价值。我们引入了基于潜在拓扑的自适应智能体（AALT），它请求能最大化起始-目标连通性预期增益的示范。我们进一步证明，该目标与任务可达性的信息增益在形式上存在关联。AALT将现有示范组织为由学习到的行为连接的潜在枢纽状态拓扑，识别可能同时启用多个任务的高价值桥梁示范，并将每个示范落实到专家查询中。在推理时，它通过所得拓扑进行规划，并将扩散策略条件化为对每个连续枢纽转换的依赖。在一个包含72个任务的模拟UR5e机器人有序取物领域中，AALT仅使用初始数据集之外的3个示范（共5个转换），便持续将成功率从42/72提升至72/72（100%）。在使用20个示范的情况下，最强的基线方法平均成功率为88.6%，使用了98个转换。

Authors: Maxwell J. Jacobson, Ahmed H Qureshi, Yexiang Xue

DITTO: Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation Manipulation

teleoperation dexterous hand exoskeleton force feedback data collection

简要说明：DITTO通过共设计7自由度机械手和运动学等价的电动外骨骼，统一了野外数据采集和带关节力反馈的双边遥操作，并在接触丰富任务上展示了灵巧操作能力。

TLDR: DITTO presents a co-designed 7-DOF robotic hand and kinematically equivalent motorized exoskeleton that unifies in-the-wild data collection and bilateral teleoperation with joint-level force feedback for dexterous manipulation, demonstrated on contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: Collecting data for manipulation with high-DOF hands is challenging, as interfaces must capture rich hand motion while rendering the contact interactions essential for precise manipulation. Existing data collection approaches face a trade-off: teleoperation ensures deployment consistency but lacks force feedback, while handheld (in-the-wild) systems provide natural force transparency but introduce a visual embodiment gap at deployment. We present DITTO, a Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation, which resolves this through the anatomically informed co-design of a dexterous 7-DOF robotic hand and a kinematically equivalent motorized exoskeleton. A 1-to-1 actuator mapping between the exoskeleton and robotic hand enables handheld (in-the-wild) data collection and bilateral teleoperation with joint-level force feedback unified in a single platform. We demonstrate that the DITTO exoskeleton spans the operator's natural index-to-thumb workspace, and showcase DITTO's dexterous capabilities via learned policies on contact-rich tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要：为高自由度机械手收集操作数据颇具挑战性，因为接口必须捕捉丰富的手部运动，同时渲染精确操作所必需的接触交互。现有数据采集方法面临权衡：遥操作确保部署一致性但缺乏力反馈，而手持式（野外）系统提供自然的力透明性但在部署时引入视觉具身差距。我们提出DITTO，一种用于透明遥操作的灵巧接口，通过解剖学信息指导的协同设计，将7自由度灵巧机械手与运动学等效的电动外骨骼相结合，解决了上述问题。外骨骼与机械手之间一对一的执行器映射，使得在单一平台上实现手持式（野外）数据采集和具有关节级力反馈的双边遥操作成为可能。我们验证了DITTO外骨骼能够覆盖操作者自然的食指至拇指工作空间，并通过接触密集任务上的学习策略展示了DITTO的灵巧操作能力。

Authors: Joaquin Palacios, Katelyn Lee, Cheng Zhang, Zhanpeng He, Matei Ciocarlie

Feedback-Modulated Harmonic Policies for Quadruped Locomotion Locomotion

quadruped locomotion Fourier series feedback modulation Unitree Go2 dynamic mode decomposition

简要说明：本文提出将四足机器人运动轨迹表示为命令条件下的傅里叶级数，并通过反馈网络在线调制，在真实Unitree Go2上实现高速奔跑和负载，同时用动态模态分解分析MLP策略中隐含的周期结构。

TLDR: This paper proposes representing quadruped locomotion joint trajectories as command-conditioned Fourier series with online feedback modulation, and demonstrates superior performance on a real Unitree Go2 robot, including high-speed running and load carrying. It also analyzes the periodic structure learned by an MLP policy using dynamic mode decomposition.

Abstract: Learned quadruped locomotion policies commonly map observations directly to joint-level actions, leaving the periodic structure of locomotion implicit in the policy. We investigate an alternative representation in which each joint trajectory is expressed as a command-conditioned Fourier series and modified online using feedback from the robot state. A context network generates the Fourier coefficients and the weights of a per-step feedback network, whose outputs adjust joint offsets, harmonic gains, frequency, and phase during execution. In simulation, we examine this explicit frequency structure alongside the hidden activations of an MLP policy that directly outputs joint targets. The harmonic waveforms change frequency and shape with commanded speed. Dynamic mode decomposition of selected MLP rollouts reveals dominant activation modes near the foot-height oscillation frequency and its second harmonic, showing periodic structure without an explicit Fourier generator. On a Unitree Go2, the simulation-trained harmonic controller records a provisional onboard-estimated peak speed of 3.67 meter per second and carries added loads up to 5.883 kilogram in separate trials.

摘要（中文）：学习型四足 locomotion 策略通常直接将观测映射到关节层级的动作，而将步态的周期性结构隐含在策略之中。我们研究了一种替代表示方法，其中每条关节轨迹被表达为命令条件下的傅里叶级数，并利用机器人状态的反馈在线调整。一个上下文网络生成傅里叶系数以及每一步反馈网络的权重，该反馈网络的输出在执行过程中调节关节偏移、谐波增益、频率和相位。在仿真中，我们将这一显式频率结构与直接输出关节目标的 MLP 策略的隐藏激活进行了对比。谐波波形随指令速度的变化而改变频率和形状。对选定 MLP 轨迹的动态模态分解揭示了接近足高振荡频率及其二次谐波的主导激活模态，表明即使没有显式傅里叶生成器，也存在周期性结构。在 Unitree Go2 上，这一经过仿真训练的谐波控制器在单次试验中记录了机载估算的暂行峰值速度，达到每秒 3.67 米，并在另一次试验中承载了高达 5.883 千克的附加负载。

Authors: Yixuan Jia, Steven Roche, Jonathan P. How

Map2Route: Benchmarking Compositional Language-Grounded Route Planning over Semantic Maps VLN

language-grounded route planning semantic maps compositional instructions benchmark code-as-grounding

简要说明：Map2Route是一个基于语义地图的组合语言引导路线规划基准，Grounding2Route方法通过可执行代码和验证引导修复在基准上优于现有方法，但仍与人类表现有差距。

TLDR: Map2Route is a benchmark for compositional language-grounded route planning over semantic maps, and Grounding2Route is a method using executable code and verification-guided repair that outperforms baselines but still lags behind human performance.

Abstract: We introduce Map2Route, a human-curated benchmark for compositional language-grounded route planning over pre-built semantic maps. Map2Route contains 1,000 episodes across 40 scenes, where instructions use relational, comparative, and nested descriptions to identify route-relevant objects and regions, while specifying ordered must-pass regions, must-avoid requirements, five categories of soft preferences, and spatial and route-stage scopes, which is partially tested by existing works. Alongside Map2Route, we propose Grounding2Route, which combines executable code-as-grounding with verification-guided repair and scope-aware planning.Across seven representative adapted baselines, Grounding2Route substantially outperforms existing methods in all metrics. Despite these gains, a substantial gap to human demonstrations remains, highlighting the difficulty of Map2Route and the considerable headroom for future progress. Additional qualitative results and resources are available on https://anonymous.4open.science/w/Map2Route-F05F/.

摘要（中文）：我们推出了Map2Route，这是一个基于人工筛选的基准测试，旨在针对预先构建的语义地图进行组合性的、以语言为依托的路线规划。Map2Route包含40个场景中的1,000个实例，其中指令利用关系描述、比较描述和嵌套描述来识别与路线相关的对象和区域，同时明确有序的必经区域、必避要求、五类软性偏好，以及空间和路线阶段的适用范围，这些内容在现有工作中仅得到部分测试。与Map2Route一同，我们提出了Grounding2Route，该方法结合了可执行的代码即依据（code-as-grounding）策略，并辅以验证引导的修复和范围感知的规划。在七个具有代表性的适配基线中，Grounding2Route在所有指标上均显著优于现有方法。尽管取得了这些进展，与人类示范之间仍存在较大差距，这凸显了Map2Route的挑战性以及未来进步的巨大空间。更多定性结果和资源可访问 https://anonymous.4open.science/w/Map2Route-F05F/。

Authors: Muyi Bao, Hang Xu, Jingfan Tang, Zihan Liu, Yuxin Cai, Chen Lv, Wenshan Wang, Ji Zhang

AthenaZero: A low-inertia, bimanual robot for dynamic manipulation Manipulation

bimanual manipulation quasi-direct drive dynamic manipulation low inertia torque transparency

简要说明：AthenaZero是一种低惯性双臂机器人，专为动态操作设计，并在棒球启发的投掷、接球和击球任务中展示了媲美人类时间尺度的能力。

TLDR: AthenaZero is a low-inertia bimanual robot designed for dynamic manipulation, demonstrated on baseball-inspired throwing, catching, and batting tasks with human-comparable timescales.

Abstract: AthenaZero is a bimanual manipulator designed to minimize inertia without compromising control authority. By utilizing quasi-direct drive actuation and transmission remotization techniques, the system achieves an effective endpoint mass comparable to that of a human---about an order of magnitude less than conventional robot manipulators. This characteristic, combined with its inherent torque transparency, makes AthenaZero exceptionally well-suited for dynamic manipulation. We describe the methodology} that led to this design and demonstrate the robot's capabilities on three baseball-inspired tasks: throwing, catching, and batting, which showcase complex interactions on human-comparable timescales where milliseconds matter. AthenaZero was capable of throwing at speeds in excess of 30 m/s, with catching and batting at speeds in excess of 14 m/s over a short 7.3 m distance. Batting practice and a game of catch were subsequently performed in robot-to-robot and human-to-robot variations, showcasing the efficacy and adaptability of our system in tasks that require high acceleration.

摘要（中文）：AthenaZero是一款双臂机械操作器，旨在在不牺牲控制权威的前提下最大限度地降低惯性。通过采用准直驱驱动与传动远端化技术，该系统实现了与人手相当的末端有效质量——比传统机器人操作器低约一个数量级。这一特性，加上其固有的力矩透明性，使AthenaZero特别适合动态操作任务。我们阐述了促成该设计的方法论，并在三项以棒球为灵感的任务中展示了该机器人的能力：投掷、接球与击球，这些任务展现了在毫秒级至关重要的、与人相当的时间尺度上的复杂交互。AthenaZero能够以超过30米/秒的速度投掷，并在短短7.3米的距离内以超过14米/秒的速度进行接球和击球。随后，在机器人与机器人以及人与机器人的变体中进行了击球练习和接球游戏，展示了我们系统在要求高加速度任务中的有效性与适应性。

Authors: Andrew S. Morgan, Gregory Xie, Capprin Bass, Rachel Thomasson, Chunpeng Wang, Erfan Shahriari, Harrison Busa, Oluwaseun Araromi, Joseph Aronov, Michael Burgess, Velin D. Dimitrov, Matthew A. Estrada, Faris Hamdi, Samuel Kendig, Taeyoon Lee, Jose Oscar Mur-Miranda, Emma Sommers, Paul Titchener, Margaret Wang, Achu Wilson, Mark Yeatman, Osman Dogan Yirmibesoglu, Alfred A. Rizzi, Annan Mozeika, Nicolas Rojas, Lael Odhner

Investigating Adversarial Robustness of Heterogeneous Cooperative Perception AutonomousDriving

cooperative perception adversarial robustness heterogeneous sensing autonomous driving feature-map attack

简要说明：本文研究了异构协同感知（CP）在车联网中的对抗鲁棒性，证明异构性并非天然防御。提出了快速无标签攻击生成器HetPoison和轻量级防御HetShield，后者可恢复83-95%的受攻击精度。

TLDR: This paper investigates the adversarial robustness of heterogeneous cooperative perception (CP) in connected vehicles, demonstrating that heterogeneity does not inherently defend against feature-map attacks. It introduces HetPoison, a fast label-free attack generator, and HetShield, a lightweight defense that recovers 83-95% of attack-degraded accuracy.

Abstract: Heterogeneous cooperative perception (CP) enables connected vehicles with diverse sensor setups to share spatial awareness via compact feature maps, where receivers reconcile these maps using learned translation modules for fusion and inference. Prior attacks against CP in a homogeneous setting reveal that the data exchange introduces a critical attack surface: a single malicious agent can transmit crafted features that erase real objects from a neighbor's fused scene. Yet, it is widely hypothesized that heterogeneity naturally defends against these attacks, as the attacker lacks knowledge of the victim's detector and the translation module scrambles adversarial gradients. We demonstrate that this protection is largely an illusion. Using a matched-objective harness to standardize the perturbation budget, objective, and forward path, we show that properly tuned iterative attacks close or reverse the apparent robustness gap. However, these optimization-based attacks require ground-truth labels and iterative backpropagation, meaning they do not represent a practical field threat running in real-time. To bridge this gap, we introduce HetPoison, a learned generator that crafts a removal perturbation in a single, label-free forward pass. HetPoison transfers across major heterogeneous designs without requiring access to the victim's detector, matching or exceeding the effectiveness of expensive optimizer-based attacks. Since heterogeneity itself is not a defense, we propose HetShield, a lightweight trust layer that validates the spatiotemporal consistency across features, recovering 83--95% of the accuracy degraded by attacks, outperforming prior art.

摘要（中文）：异构协同感知（CP）使配备不同传感器配置的网联车辆能够通过紧凑的特征图共享空间感知信息，接收方利用学习得到的转换模块对这些特征图进行协调，以完成融合与推理。先前在同构场景下针对CP的攻击表明，数据交换引入了关键的攻击面：单个恶意智能体可传输经过精心构造的特征，从而从邻居的融合场景中抹除真实物体。然而，人们普遍假设异构性能够天然防御此类攻击，因为攻击者缺乏对受害者检测器的了解，且转换模块会扰乱对抗梯度。我们证明这种保护在很大程度上是一种错觉。通过使用目标匹配的测试框架来标准化扰动预算、目标和前向路径，我们表明经过恰当调优的迭代攻击能够缩小甚至逆转表面上的鲁棒性差距。然而，这些基于优化的攻击需要真实标注和迭代反向传播，这意味着它们并不构成能在实时场景中运行的实际现场威胁。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了HetPoison——一种学习型生成器，能够在单次无标签的前向传播中构造移除扰动。HetPoison可跨主流异构设计迁移，无需访问受害者的检测器，其有效性可媲美甚至超越代价高昂的基于优化的攻击。由于异构性本身并非防御手段，我们进一步提出HetShield——一种轻量级信任层，用于验证特征间的时空一致性，可恢复被攻击所降低的83%至95%的精度，性能优于现有方法。

Authors: Chenyi Wang, Yutong Liu, Qingzhao Zhang, Ming F. Li

VCTP: Vehicle-Conditioned Terrain Planning for Off-Road Navigation Other

terrain planning off-road navigation vehicle-conditioned wheel-contact sampling D* Lite

简要说明：VCTP 是一种用于越野导航的地形规划方法，通过在多个车辆航向和车轮接触点评估地面，降低建模成本，并通过选择性更新适应地图变化。

TLDR: VCTP is a terrain planning method for off-road navigation that evaluates surfaces at multiple vehicle headings and wheel contacts, reducing modeled costs and adapting to map changes via selective updates.

Abstract: A vehicle's heading affects both the surfaces beneath its tires and its pitch and roll. We present Vehicle-Conditioned Terrain Planning (VCTP), which retains these relationships by evaluating shared elevation and surface-ID layers at eight headings. Body geometry constrains admissibility, while loaded wheel contacts determine modeled surface cost and predicted pitch and roll. Established D* Lite and vehicle-state search use these evaluations to plan routes with forward and reverse motion. When observations change, VCTP recomputes every affected body or contact query. In fully observed two-track simulations, sampling at wheel contacts rather than at the vehicle center lowers modeled surface cost by 39.3% while shortening the route. In offline planning on RGator recordings, VCTP also reduces modeled costs over identified surfaces and observed support relative to distance-focused planning, although incomplete coverage leaves full-route rankings unresolved. Selective updates match full recomputation in all 474 comparisons using recorded map changes. These results identify when wheel-contact placement and vehicle heading affect route choice.

摘要（中文）：车辆的航向会影响其轮胎下方的地表以及自身的俯仰和侧倾。我们提出了车辆状态地形规划（VCTP）方法，该方法通过评估八个航向下的共享高程层和地表标识层来保留这些关系。车身几何结构约束了可通行性，而加载的车轮接触点则决定了模型化的地表成本和预测的俯仰及侧倾。已建立的D* Lite算法和车辆状态搜索利用这些评估结果，在前进和倒车运动中规划路径。当观测发生变化时，VCTP会重新计算每一个受影响的车辆车身或接触点查询。在全观测的双轨仿真中，相比于在车辆中心采样，在车轮接触点采样使模型化地表成本降低了39.3%，同时缩短了路径。在RGator记录数据的离线规划中，VCTP相较于以距离为重点的规划，在已识别地表和观测支撑方面也降低了模型化成本，尽管覆盖不完整使得全程路径排名问题未能解决。在所有474次使用记录地图变化的比较中，选择性更新与完全重新计算保持一致。这些结果揭示了车轮接触点位置和车辆航向何时会影响路径选择。

Authors: Akshay Naik, Ramavarapu S. Sreenivas, Dustin Nottage, Ahmet Soylemezoglu

Adaptive-MHE : A Sampling-Based Adaptive MPC for Legged Loco-Manipulation via Moving Horizon Estimation Locomotion

sampling-based system identification moving horizon estimation model predictive control loco-manipulation legged robots

简要说明：Adaptive-MHE提出了一种基于移动horizon估计的在线采样系统辨识框架，并与采样MPC结合，估计物体和地形参数，以实现腿式机器人在变化环境中的自适应操作，并在仿真和硬件上验证。

TLDR: Adaptive-MHE proposes an online sampling-based system identification framework via moving horizon estimation, coupled with a sampling-based MPC, to estimate object and terrain parameters for adaptive legged loco-manipulation in changing environments, validating on simulation and hardware.

Abstract: Legged robots have demonstrated a remarkable ability to traverse various terrains, yet generating effective loco-manipulation behaviors remains challenging. A key difficulty is that object and terrain parameters are typically unknown to the robot, and mismatches between these parameters and their simulated counterparts introduce a sim-to-real gap that degrades control performance. Classical system identification (Sys-ID) methods often assume differentiable dynamics, an assumption that does not hold for contact-rich legged systems. Sampling-based Sys-ID avoids this restriction by directly matching simulated and recorded state trajectories through massively parallel rollouts, but existing approaches are typically applied offline and do not adapt as environmental conditions change. We present Adaptive-MHE an online sampling-based Sys-ID framework, based on moving horizon estimation (MHE), that estimates the physical parameters of objects and terrain in the environment (e.g., mass, friction) and couples this estimate with a sampling-based model predictive controller, enabling adaptive loco-manipulation in changing and uncertain environments. In simulation and hardware experiments, our framework consistently outperforms baselines and matches the performance of a controller with access to ground-truth parameters.

摘要（中文）：腿式机器人已展现出在多种地形上行走的卓越能力，然而生成有效的移动操控行为仍具挑战性。一个关键难点在于，物体和地形的参数通常对机器人而言是未知的，而这些参数与其仿真对应物之间的不匹配会引入仿真到现实的差距，从而降低控制性能。经典的系统辨识（Sys-ID）方法往往假设动力学可微，这一假设对于接触丰富的腿式系统并不成立。基于采样的系统辨识通过大规模并行 rollout 直接匹配仿真与记录的状态轨迹，从而避开了这一限制，但现有方法通常离线应用，无法随环境条件变化而自适应调整。我们提出了 Adaptive-MHE，一种基于移动时域估计（MHE）的在线采样式系统辨识框架，它能够估计环境中物体和地形的物理参数（如质量、摩擦力），并将该估计与基于采样的模型预测控制器相结合，从而在变化且不确定的环境中实现自适应移动操控。在仿真和硬件实验中，我们的框架持续优于基线方法，并与能够获取真实参数的控制器性能相当。

Authors: Hossein Keshavarz, Alejandro Ramirez-Serrano, Majid Khadiv

HINT-Plan: Human Intention-Aware Robot Task Planning in Context-Rich Environments using Vision Language Models VLA

Vision Language Models Human intention prediction Task planning Scene Graphs Human-aware robot decision-making

简要说明：HINT-Plan利用视觉语言模型从图像预测人类意图，将其转化为目标状态，并结合层次场景图和形式化规划语言解决上下文丰富环境中的联合人机任务规划问题，在仿真中显著提升了成功率。

TLDR: HINT-Plan uses Vision Language Models to predict human intentions from images, convert them into goal states, and solve joint human-robot task planning in context-rich environments using hierarchical scene graphs and formal planning languages, achieving significant improvements in success rate over baselines in simulation.

Abstract: Approaches to incorporating human awareness into mobile robot decision-making mainly focus on collision avoidance in low-level motion planning, often overlooking the challenges posed by human presence and high-level behavior. To address this vacancy, we present HINT-Plan, a novel approach to integrate human intention prediction into robot task planning. HINT-Plan employs Vision Language Models (VLMs) to anticipate high-level human intentions from third-person image observations, convert them into goal states, and solve joint task-planning problems. To effectively enable scene awareness in context-rich environments, we use hierarchical Scene Graphs (SGs) as high-level representations of the environment, and translate environmental topology and actionable knowledge into formal planning language to ensure executable plans. Evaluated in a photorealistic simulation, HINT-Plan achieves an overall success rate of 69.71% in joint human-robot task planning, substantially outperforming the baselines by up to 35.29%, while also reducing functional conflicts. The results show the effectiveness of explicitly incorporating inferred human intentions into formal multi-agent task planning for proactive human-aware robot decision-making.

摘要（中文）：将人类感知纳入移动机器人决策的方法主要集中于低层运动规划中的碰撞避免，往往忽视了人类存在及高层行为所带来的挑战。为填补这一空白，我们提出了HINT-Plan，一种将人类意图预测融入机器人任务规划的新方法。HINT-Plan利用视觉语言模型（VLMs）从第三人称图像观察中预测高层人类意图，将其转化为目标状态，并求解联合任务规划问题。为了在上下文丰富的环境中有效实现场景感知，我们使用层次化场景图（SGs）作为环境的高层表示，并将环境拓扑及可操作知识转化为正式规划语言，以确保规划方案可执行。在逼真仿真环境中的评估表明，HINT-Plan在人机联合任务规划中实现了69.71%的总体成功率，比基线方法高出最多35.29%，同时减少了功能冲突。研究结果表明，将推断出的人类意图显式纳入正式的多智能体任务规划，对于实现主动式人类感知机器人决策是有效的。

Authors: Yuchen Liu, Luigi Palmieri, Lujun Li, Radu State, Ilche Georgievski, Marco Aiello

DRT&R: Direct Radar Teach & Repeat Other

radar navigation teach and repeat local mapping closed-loop off-road

简要说明：DRT&R 是一种基于直接雷达的教导与重复导航系统，结合直接雷达处理与局部建图，在道路和越野场景中实现最先进的定位精度，并在真实越野车辆上进行了闭环自主导航验证。

TLDR: DRT&R is a direct radar-based teach-and-repeat navigation stack that combines direct radar processing with local mapping, achieving SOTA localization accuracy on-road and off-road and demonstrating closed-loop autonomous navigation on a real off-road vehicle.

Abstract: Radar-based navigation is appealing for its robustness to adverse conditions involving airborne particles, such as precipitation, dust, fog, and smoke, that can cause lidar-based systems to fail. Recently, direct methods that retain and use the entire radar scan rather than sparse points have improved on-road global localization performance. However, they have yet to be deployed in off-road environments or in closed-loop systems. Additionally, even direct global maps may lose information: their global nature leads to a smoothing out of viewpoint-dependent radar artifacts, which can provide pose information when mapping and localization occur along similar trajectories. This paper introduces Direct Radar Teach & Repeat (DRT&R): a direct spinning radar-based navigation stack that maximizes the amount of retained information by combining direct radar processing with local mapping. DRT&R yields state-of-the-art (SOTA) localization performance in both on-road and off-road environments. Using 344 km of on-road data and 20 km of off-road data, DRT&R is able to localize to within 4 cm in most on-road and off-road conditions, and 12 cm in geometrically degenerate and sparse environments. DRT&R is also evaluated autonomously in closed loop with an MPC controller for more than 10 km using a Clearpath Warthog off-road vehicle, demonstrating that it runs in real time and achieves SOTA tracking performance for off-road radar navigation.

摘要（中文）：基于雷达的导航因其对降水、尘埃、雾和烟雾等含空气颗粒物的恶劣条件的鲁棒性而备受青睐，这些条件可能导致基于激光雷达的系统失效。近年来，保留并使用整个雷达扫描而非稀疏点的直接方法提高了道路环境下的全局定位性能。然而，这些方法尚未在越野环境或闭环系统中得到应用。此外，即使是直接全局地图也可能丢失信息：其全局性会导致依赖于视角的雷达伪影被平滑处理，而当建图和定位沿相似轨迹进行时，这些伪影可以提供位姿信息。本文介绍了直接雷达“教与复”系统（DRT&R）：一种基于直接旋转雷达的导航系统，通过将直接雷达处理与局部地图相结合，最大化保留的信息量。DRT&R在道路和越野环境中均达到了最先进的定位性能。利用344公里的道路数据和20公里的越野数据，DRT&R在大多数道路和越野条件下能够实现4厘米以内的定位精度，在几何退化及稀疏环境中实现12厘米以内的定位精度。DRT&R还与MPC控制器闭环集成，使用Clearpath Warthog越野车进行了超过10公里的自主评估，证明了其实时运行能力，并在越野雷达导航中达到了最先进的跟踪性能。

Authors: Alexander Krawciw, Daniil Lisus, Cedric Le Gentil, Timothy D. Barfoot

CALOS: Control-Affine Lyapunov On-manifold Safety Layer for Safe Deep Reinforcement Learning for Quadrotors RLRobot

safety layer quadrotor control quadratic program attitude constraints deep reinforcement learning

简要说明：CALOS 是一种用于四旋翼深度强化学习的运行时安全层，通过二次规划强制姿态约束，在 Isaac Lab 中降低了跟踪误差并实现了零约束违反。

TLDR: CALOS is a runtime safety layer for quadrotor deep reinforcement learning that enforces attitude constraints via a quadratic program, reducing tracking error and achieving zero constraint violations in Isaac Lab.

Abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning has demonstrated remarkable capability in quadrotor control, yet learned policies offer no guarantee of respecting safety constraints during training or deployment. We present CALOS (Control-Affine Lyapunov On-manifold Safety), a runtime safety layer that enforces attitude constraints on a quadrotor without modifying the underlying learning algorithm. CALOS formulates four tilt-angle inequalities and a Lyapunov descent condition as a single quadratic program whose solution is the minimum-norm correction to the nominal torque output of the policy. The quadratic program is solved exactly via active-set enumeration over the three-dimensional torque space, with a computational cost low enough to enforce constraints in real time across thousands of parallel simulation environments, as required by modern massively parallel Deep Reinforcement Learning training. Evaluated on trajectory-tracking tasks in NVIDIA Isaac Lab, CALOS reduces lateral tracking error by 55-60% relative to an unconstrained Proximal Policy Optimization baseline while achieving zero attitude-constraint violations on the training trajectory. By restricting exploration to safe regions of the state space, the safety layer also accelerates training convergence and improves data efficiency without producing suboptimal policies.

摘要（中文）：深度强化学习在四旋翼控制领域展现出卓越能力，然而学习所得策略在训练或部署过程中无法保证满足安全约束。我们提出CALOS（控制仿射李雅普诺夫流形上安全）方法，这是一种运行时安全层，在不修改底层学习算法的情况下对四旋翼施加速度约束。CALOS将四个倾斜角不等式及一个李雅普诺夫下降条件整合为单一二次规划问题，其解即为对策略标称力矩输出的最小范数修正。该二次规划通过三维力矩空间上的有效集枚举精确求解，计算成本足够低，可在数千并行仿真环境中实时执行约束，满足现代大规模并行深度强化学习训练的需求。在NVIDIA Isaac Lab轨迹跟踪任务上的评估表明，相较于无约束的近端策略优化基线，CALOS将横向跟踪误差降低55%至60%，同时在训练轨迹上实现零速度约束违反。通过将探索限制在状态空间的安全区域内，该安全层还加速了训练收敛并提升数据效率，且不会产生次优策略。

Authors: Fabrizio Cesareo, Sebastiano Mengozzi, Nicola Mimmo, Andrea Acquaviva

Imitation Learning for Autonomous Driving in CARLA AutonomousDriving

behavioral cloning multimodal policy CARLA simulator closed-loop driving offline demonstrations

简要说明：本文研究了一个紧凑的多模态策略能从CARLA模拟器中的离线演示中获取多少闭环驾驶能力，并发布了训练好的策略，该策略在数小时内无碰撞自动驾驶并迁移到未见过的城镇。

TLDR: This paper studies how much closed-loop driving competence a compact multimodal policy can acquire from offline demonstrations in the CARLA simulator, releasing a 1.36M parameter policy trained on 236,882 windows that drives autonomously for hours without collisions and transfers to unseen towns.

Abstract: Behavioral cloning trains a policy offline on expert demonstrations, but deployment is closed loop: each action affects the observations the policy receives next. We study how much closed-loop driving competence a compact multimodal policy can acquire from offline demonstrations in the CARLA simulator. The policy uses five-frame histories of RGB images, LiDAR, vehicle telemetry, and lane waypoints to predict throttle, brake, and steering at 20 Hz. Demonstrations were collected in three stages, ending with a systematic route-generation procedure that enumerates spawn points and feasible maneuvers and verifies completed autopilot routes. The released 1.36 million parameter policy was trained on 236,882 windows, representing about 3.3 hours of driving from 448 captures. The resulting policy drives autonomously for hours on training and held-out routes. In our runs, it did so without collisions and also transferred qualitatively to an unseen CARLA town with different road geometry. We also observed recovery from large trajectory deviations, although we do not claim systematic recovery without controlled evaluation. We report offline metrics and distinguish measured results from qualitative closed-loop observations. We release the code, trained checkpoint, ONNX model, data sample, and an evidence audit for the reported claims.

摘要（中文）：行为克隆通过在专家演示上进行离线训练来学习策略，但其部署是闭环的：每个动作都会影响策略后续接收到的观测。我们研究了在CARLA模拟器中，一个紧凑的多模态策略能从离线演示中习得多少闭环驾驶能力。该策略利用五帧历史的RGB图像、激光雷达、车辆遥测数据以及车道路径点，以20赫兹的频率预测油门、制动和转向。演示数据分三个阶段收集，最终采用系统化的路线生成流程，枚举生成点与可行操作，并验证完成的自动驾驶路线。所发布的具有136万参数的策略在236，882个窗口上进行了训练，这些窗口代表了来自448次采集的约3.3小时驾驶数据。最终形成的策略能够在训练路线和未见的保留路线上自主驾驶数小时。在我们的测试中，该策略未发生碰撞，并且还定性地迁移到了一个道路几何结构不同的未见CARLA城镇。我们还观察到了对大幅轨迹偏差的恢复能力，尽管我们不宣称在缺乏受控评估的情况下具有系统性恢复能力。我们报告了离线指标，并将实测结果与定性闭环观测区分开来。我们公开发布了代码、训练好的检查点、ONNX模型、数据样本以及所报告主张的证据审计。

Authors: Jordy Kieto

REVERSAL-BENCH: A Reversibility Axis and Reset Oracle for Measuring the Reset-Free RL Cliff RLRobot

reset-free RL reversibility manipulation benchmark reset oracle

简要说明：REVERSAL-BENCH 通过可逆性参数和重置预言机揭示了“无重置强化学习悬崖”：在不可逆操作任务中，无重置智能体会陷入不可恢复状态而无法学习，而回合制智能体则保持稳定学习。

TLDR: REVERSAL-BENCH is a benchmark with a reversibility parameter and reset oracle that reveals a 'reset-free RL cliff': reset-free agents become permanently trapped in irrecoverable states in irreversible manipulation tasks, whereas episodic agents learn steadily.

Abstract: A central goal of autonomous reinforcement learning is continuous policy training without external resets. However, existing paradigms largely depend on underlying environmental reversibility, a property absent in real world manipulation, where events such as pushing objects off tables or spilling granular substances cannot be undone. We introduce REVERSAL-BENCH, a benchmark that controls reversibility via a continuous parameter $ρ\in [0, 1]$ and provides a reset oracle, a ground-truth verification mechanism to test state recoverability across eight manipulation settings in five physics engines. Evaluating a broad spectrum of policy architectures, including standard actor-critic algorithms, safe RL, and specialized reset-free frameworks, reveals a sharp reversibility cliff: reset-free agents are consistently absorbed into irrecoverable states as $ρ$ increases, whereas episodic agents maintain steady learning. We see this failure mode across autonomous reset-free baselines and constrained RL. Because reset-free agents lack external resets, any transition into an irrecoverable state results in permanent absorption, leaving the agent trapped where further learning halts. We show that this absorption phenomenon persists in full physics simulations under learned manipulation policies. By evaluating against geometrically identical reversible counterparts, we confirm that this breakdown is causally driven by irreversibility rather than obstacle complexity. We release the benchmark suite, a large multi-simulator dataset labeled with recoverability and a reset oracle. We also evaluate a safety shield that intervenes before irreversible failures occur, showing that while recoverability can be predicted accurately, active recovery primarily succeeds only when the agent can physically steer clear of the trap

摘要（中文）：自主强化学习的一个核心目标是实现无需外部重置的持续策略训练。然而，现有范式在很大程度上依赖于环境内在的可逆性，而这一属性在现实世界的操作任务中并不存在——例如，将物体推落桌面或洒落颗粒状物质等事件无法被撤销。我们提出了REVERSAL-BENCH基准，该基准通过连续参数$ρ\in [0, 1]$控制可逆性，并提供重置预言器（reset oracle）这一真值验证机制，用于在五个物理引擎中的八种操作场景下测试状态的可恢复性。对包括标准演员-评论家算法、安全强化学习以及专用无重置框架在内的广泛策略架构进行评测后，我们发现了一个显著的可逆性悬崖：随着$ρ$增大，无重置智能体持续被吸收进不可恢复状态，而回合制智能体则保持稳定的学习进度。我们在自主无重置基线和受约束强化学习方法中都观察到了这一失效模式。由于无重置智能体缺乏外部重置机制，任何进入不可恢复状态的转移都会导致永久吸收，使智能体被困其中，进一步的学习也随之停滞。我们证明，这种吸收现象在完整物理模拟中，在习得操作策略的作用下依然存在。通过与几何形状完全相同的可逆对应场景进行对比评估，我们确认这一崩溃现象是由不可逆性因果关系驱动的，而非障碍物复杂度所致。我们发布了该基准套件，其中包括一个带有可恢复性标注的大规模多模拟器数据集以及一个重置预言器。我们还评估了一种在不可逆失效发生前进行干预的安全防护机制，结果表明，虽然可恢复性可以被准确预测，但主动恢复仅在智能体能够从物理上避开陷阱时才能有效实现。

Sim-to-Real Traffic Scene Understanding by Decoupling Semantics from Caption Generation with V-JEPA AutonomousDriving

V-JEPA visual question answering traffic event description semantic refinement sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出了一种解耦的语义理解框架，用于交通场景VQA和事件描述生成，利用冻结的V-JEPA编码器、轻量级Llama预测器和结构化语义优化，在2026年AI城市挑战赛Track 2中取得第一名。

TLDR: This paper proposes a decoupled semantic understanding framework for traffic scene VQA and event description generation, using a frozen V-JEPA encoder, a lightweight Llama-based predictor, and structured semantic refinement, achieving first place in the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 2.

Abstract: Track 2 of the AI City Challenge 2026 requires both visual question answering (VQA) and traffic event description generation under a challenging synthetic-to real domain shift. Existing vision-language approaches often entangle semantic understanding with language generation, making them susceptible to hallucination and inconsistent reasoning across event phases. In this work, we propose a decoupled semantic understanding framework that first resolves predefined traffic questions into structured semantic facts and subsequently uses these facts to guide caption generation. A frozen V-JEPA encoder extracts predictive scene representations, while a lightweight Llama-based predictor produces answers for VQA queries. To improve reliability, we introduce a training-free structured refinement mechanism that exploits statistical priors, inter-question relationships, and temporal event consistency to correct prediction errors. The refined semantic facts are then provided to Qwen3-VL-8B to generate pedestrian and vehicle descriptions for each traffic event. Experimental results on the official 2026 AI City Challenge Track 2 benchmark show that the proposed method achieves 87.09% VQA accuracy and an overall S2 score of 60.0853, ranking first among all participating teams. These results demonstrate that predictive world representations combined with structured semantic refinement enable more accurate and reliable traffic understanding, leading to higher-quality lan guage generation.

摘要（中文）：2026年人工智能城市挑战赛赛道2要求在具有挑战性的合成到真实域迁移条件下，同时完成视觉问答（VQA）和交通事件描述生成。现有的视觉-语言方法往往将语义理解与语言生成纠缠在一起，使其容易产生幻觉，并在事件各阶段之间出现推理不一致的问题。在本工作中，我们提出了一种解耦的语义理解框架，该框架首先将预定义的交通问题解析为结构化语义事实，随后利用这些事实引导描述文本的生成。冻结的V-JEPA编码器提取预测性场景表示，而基于Llama的轻量级预测器则负责生成VQA查询的答案。为提高可靠性，我们引入了一种无需训练的结构化修正机制，该机制利用统计先验、问题间关系以及时间事件一致性来纠正预测错误。修正后的语义事实随后被提供给Qwen3-VL-8B，以生成每个交通事件的行人与车辆描述。在2026年人工智能城市挑战赛赛道2官方基准上的实验结果表明，所提出的方法达到了87.09%的VQA准确率和60.0853的综合S2分数，在全部参赛队伍中排名第一。这些结果证明，预测性世界表示与结构化语义修正相结合，能够实现更准确、更可靠的交通理解，从而产生更高质量的语言生成。

Accuracy- and Real-Time-Aware 4D Radar Preprocessing for Autonomous Driving Perception Systems AutonomousDriving

简要说明：本文提出一种用于自动驾驶的4D雷达预处理框架，包括基于百分位数的形状保持、基于核密度估计的多帧噪点判别以及嵌入式适配性评估，提升了嵌入式平台上3D目标检测的准确性和实时性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a 4D radar preprocessing framework for autonomous driving, including percentile-based shape preservation, multi-frame noise discrimination using KDE, and an embedded suitability metric, improving 3D object detection accuracy and real-time performance on embedded platforms.

Abstract: 4D radar has emerged as a promising next-generation sensor for improving the robustness of autonomous driving perception systems because of its stable sensing capability under adverse weather conditions. However, deploying 4D radar in embedded environments with limited hardware resources requires radar-representation preprocessing that jointly considers perception accuracy, real-time performance, and computational complexity. This paper proposes a preprocessing framework for 4D-radar-based 3D object detection. First, Percentile-based 3D Shape Preservation (P3DP) extracts point clouds from radar tensors while preserving object-shape information and suppressing noise and false alarms. Second, Multi-frame-based Noise Point Discrimination using Kernel Density Estimation (MF-KDE) improves the density and reliability of sparse radar point clouds. Finally, Embedded \& NetScore (ENS) evaluates suitability for embedded deployment by jointly considering accuracy, real-time performance, adverse-weather robustness, and model complexity.

摘要（中文）：4D雷达因其在恶劣天气条件下的稳定感知能力，已成为提升自动驾驶感知系统鲁棒性的新一代传感器方案。然而，在硬件资源受限的嵌入式环境中部署4D雷达，需要联合考虑感知精度、实时性能和计算复杂度的雷达表示预处理。本文提出了一种基于4D雷达的三维目标检测预处理框架。首先，基于百分位数的三维形状保持（P3DP）方法从雷达张量中提取点云，同时保留物体形状信息并抑制噪声和虚警。其次，基于多帧核密度估计的噪声点判别（MF-KDE）方法提高了稀疏雷达点云的密度和可靠性。最后，嵌入式与网络评分（ENS）方法通过联合考虑精度、实时性能、恶劣天气鲁棒性和模型复杂度，评估嵌入式部署的适用性。

Authors: Woo-Jin Jung, Dong-Hee Paek, Jeong-Su Park, Seung-Hyun Kong

Learning from Distributed Eyes: Leveraging Collaborative Perception for Automated Model Adaptation AutonomousDriving

collaborative perception unsupervised domain adaptation 3D object detection pseudo-labeling curriculum learning

简要说明：LDE 利用多车协同感知生成高质量的伪标签，用于自动驾驶中 3D 目标检测器的无监督域适应，并解决了通信、视角差异和标签噪声等问题。

TLDR: LDE leverages collaborative perception from multiple vehicles to generate high-quality pseudo-labels for unsupervised domain adaptation of 3D object detectors in autonomous driving, addressing communication, view discrepancy, and label noise issues.

Abstract: In autonomous driving, perception models often struggle to generalize to new environments due to domain shifts. While unsupervised model adaptation offers a feasible solution without labor-intensive manual labeling, existing methods that rely solely on the ego-vehicle's data often lead to inferior pseudo-labeling performance. To address this critical issue, we propose LDE, Learning from Distributed ``Eyes", a novel framework that transforms collaborative perception (CP) into a source of high-quality supervision for model adaptation. This pseudo-labeling approach is hyperparameter-insensitive and relatively reliable, assuming CP often outperforms single-agent's perception. However, naively implementing this approach encounters (1) the communication bottleneck of sharing rich features under time and bandwidth constraints, (2) the view discrepancy between the CP view and the learner's Field of View (FoV), and (3) the unreliability even in CP-generated labels. To address these issues, we design an adaptation-oriented feature sharing mechanism that selectively transmits the most critical information for adaptation, an FoV filtering method that meticulously eliminates mismatched labels, and a curriculum learning strategy to progressively exploit pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on 3D object detection tasks demonstrate that LDE consistently outperforms both the pre-trained models and state-of-the-art unsupervised adaptation methods.

摘要（中文）：在自动驾驶领域，感知模型常因域偏移而难以泛化至新环境。尽管无监督模型自适应提供了一种无需繁重人工标注的可行方案，但现有依赖单车数据的方法往往导致伪标签性能不佳。针对这一关键问题，我们提出LDE（Learning from Distributed "Eyes"，从分布式“眼睛”中学习）——一种新颖框架，将协同感知（CP）转化为模型自适应的优质监督来源。该伪标签方法对超参数不敏感且相对可靠，前提是协同感知通常优于单智能体感知。然而，直接实施该方法面临以下挑战：（1）在时间和带宽限制下共享丰富特征所导致的通信瓶颈；（2）协同感知视图与学习者视野（FoV）之间的视角差异；（3）即使协同感知生成的标签也存在不可靠性。为解决这些问题，我们设计了面向自适应的特征共享机制，选择性地传输对自适应最关键的信息；一种视野过滤方法，精细剔除不匹配的标签；以及一种课程学习策略，逐步利用伪标签。在3D目标检测任务上的大量实验表明，LDE consistently优于预训练模型及最先进的无监督自适应方法。

Authors: Yanan Ma, Yihang Tao, Zhengru Fang, Zihan Fang, Yiqin Deng, Xianhao Chen, Yuguang Fang

Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control WorldModel

World model action-text conditioning real-time interaction streaming generation navigation control

简要说明：Zing-0.5 提出一个 5B 自回归世界模型，通过联合键盘和文本控制实现实时可交互的生成世界，采用统一动作文本条件、事件级监督蒸馏和流式生成，以24 FPS运行并支持生成过程中文本引导事件改变。

TLDR: Zing-0.5 introduces a 5B autoregressive world model that enables real-time playable worlds with joint keyboard and text control, using unified action-text conditioning, event-scale supervision via distillation, and streaming generation at 24 FPS. It demonstrates improved navigation consistency and allows text-directed event changes during continued generation.

Abstract: We introduce Zing-0.5, a 5B autoregressive world model designed for playability: users can explore generated worlds, influence unfolding events, and respond to the resulting feedback through joint keyboard and online text control. Our approach brings together three technical contributions: (1) Unified action and text conditioning, combining magnitude-aware keyboard inputs with temporally aligned text instructions and jointly annotated videos to learn navigation and event control within the same sequence; (2) Event-scale supervision for incremental generation, using a segment-level teacher trained on connected multi-prompt videos to supervise a block-level causal student through distribution-matching distillation; and (3) Low-cost real-time interaction, combining four-step generation with context-preserving streaming to support 832 x 480 inference at 24 FPS at an estimated server rental cost of approximately USD 0.009 per stream-minute. Zing-0.5 achieves an overall score of 81.0 and a consistency score of 88.5 across 158 WBench Navigation cases. A joint-control demonstration shows a text-directed event change during continued navigation without restarting generation. We release the model weights, inference code, and Zing-SGLang serving implementation to support further work on playable generated worlds.

摘要（中文）：我们推出Zing-0.5，一个5B参数的自回归世界模型，专为可玩性设计：用户能够探索生成的世界、影响不断展开的事件，并通过键盘与在线文本的联合操控来应对随之而来的反馈。我们的方法汇集了三项技术贡献：（1）统一动作与文本条件化，将幅度感知的键盘输入与时间对齐的文本指令及联合标注的视频相结合，在同一序列中学习导航与事件控制；（2）面向增量生成的事件级监督，利用在连接的多提示视频上训练的分段级教师模型，通过分布匹配蒸馏来监督块级因果学生模型；（3）低成本的实时交互，将四步生成与上下文保留流式处理相结合，支持在预计服务器租金约为每分钟流式0.009美元的条件下，以24 FPS进行832×480分辨率的推理。Zing-0.5在158个WBench导航案例中取得了81.0的综合得分和88.5的一致性得分。联合控制演示展示了在持续导航过程中，无需重启生成即可通过文本引导实现事件改变。我们发布了模型权重、推理代码以及Zing-SGLang服务实现，以支持有关可玩生成世界的进一步研究。

Authors: Mingyang Chen, Shengdong Chen, Xiaoxiao Fu, Bosheng Gong, Haoyuan Guo, Bowen Li, Jiawen Li, Kejun Li, Tianpeng Li, Yin Liu, Haoze Sun, Zeyang Tian, Meng Wang, Xinmiao Wu, Jiangqiao Yan, Zining Zhao

Active perception for robotic harvesting: 3D reconstruction and localisation of tomatoes hidden within clusters in a Mediterranean greenhouse Perception3D

active perception 3D reconstruction occluded fruit localization Next Best View robotic harvesting

简要说明：本文提出了一种五阶段主动感知流程，用于地中海温室中簇生番茄的3D重建与定位，包括NBV规划、滤波、分割、聚类和位姿估计，在仿真中实现了高精度和高准确率。

TLDR: This paper presents a five-stage active perception pipeline for 3D reconstruction and localization of occluded tomatoes in clusters within Mediterranean greenhouses, using an NBV planner, filtering, segmentation, clustering, and pose estimation, achieving high precision and accuracy in simulation.

Abstract: Automating robotic harvesting in intensive agriculture within Mediterranean greenhouses requires overcoming significant challenges related to the geometric complexity of plants and occluded fruits. Although existing literature offers solutions targeting crops that grow in isolation (e.g., apples, sweet peppers, or peaches), the fundamental challenge lies in cluster-growing vegetables, where fixed sensors mounted on robotic systems fail to detect fruits hidden behind the visible surface. To address this limitation, this study presents a comprehensive pipeline for the 3D reconstruction and precise localization of each fruit within a cluster, including heavily occluded instances. The proposed methodology is structured into five sequential stages: i) point cloud acquisition using the AgriSEE Next Best View (NBV) active planner; ii) stochastic noise filtering via Statistical Outlier Removal (SOR); iii) surface classification and segmentation using Region Growing (RG); iv) isolation and recovery of occluded fruits through Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN); and v) 3D pose estimation (position and orientation). This approach extracts the complete cluster geometry, ensuring the reliable identification of partially hidden tomatoes. Evaluated across multiple scenarios with varying occlusion levels within a simulation framework rigorously validated against real-world conditions, the system achieves a precision exceeding 90\%, an average recall of 82.8\%, and a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 80.7\%. Furthermore, it demonstrates high repeatability in centroid estimation with a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of merely 4.2~mm, verifying its technical feasibility and high accuracy for autonomous harvesting operations.

摘要（中文）：自动化地中海温室中集约化农业的机器人采摘，需克服与植物几何复杂性和果实遮挡相关的重大挑战。尽管现有文献提供了针对孤立生长作物（如苹果、甜椒或桃子）的解决方案，但根本难点在于簇生蔬菜，其中安装在机器人系统上的固定传感器无法检测到隐藏于可见表面之后的果实。为解决这一局限，本研究提出了一套完整的流程，用于对簇内每颗果实（包括严重遮挡实例）进行三维重建与精确定位。所提出的方法分为五个依次进行的阶段：（i）使用AgriSEE Next Best View（NBV）主动规划器采集点云；（ii）通过统计离群值移除（SOR）进行随机噪声滤波；（iii）使用区域生长（RG）进行表面分类与分割；（iv）通过基于密度的噪声应用空间聚类（DBSCAN）分离并恢复被遮挡的果实；以及（v）三维姿态估计（位置与方向）。该方法提取了完整的簇几何结构，确保可靠识别部分隐藏的番茄。在多种遮挡程度的模拟场景中进行了评估，且该模拟框架经过严格对照真实条件验证，系统实现了超过90%的精度、82.8%的平均召回率以及80.7%的平均交并比（mIoU）。此外，在质心估计方面展现出高重复性，其均方根误差（RMSE）仅为4.2毫米，验证了该技术在自主采摘作业中的可行性与高精度。
