Authors: Fernando Cañadas-Aránega, Rowan Border, José C. Moreno, José L. Blanco-Claraco

HAP: A Hand-Driven Active Perception Framework for Egocentric Head Motion Prediction Perception3D

Egocentric Motion Forecasting Head Motion Prediction Active Perception Occlusion Reasoning 6-DoF

简要说明：HAP是一个由手部运动驱动的以自我为中心的6自由度头部运动预测框架，它通过推断目标物体置信度并利用预测图建模遮挡，在公共数据集和新数据集上取得了更低的预测误差。

TLDR: HAP is a framework for egocentric 6-DoF head motion prediction driven by hand motion, which infers target object confidence and models occlusion using a predictive graph, achieving lower prediction errors on public and new datasets.

Abstract: Egocentric motion forecasting has primarily focused on hands and manipulated objects, leaving future human head motion comparatively underexplored. During manipulation, the head both redirects perception toward the target to acquire task-relevant evidence and coordinates with body and hand motion. We therefore formulate future six Degree of Freedom (6-DoF) head-motion prediction conditioned on observed hand motion and inferred target context, and propose HAP, a Hand-Driven Active Perception framework. HAP infers confidence for each target object from observed hand motion and object geometry. Then constructs a dynamic Predictive Target-Centric Amodal Occlusion Graph (P-TAOG) representing current and potential occlusion among candidate objects. Directed graph and causal temporal reasoning encode the evolving target conditioned perceptual state, which is fused with hand and head motion history. A horizon-wise gate then blends the learned trajectory with a constant velocity prior. We further introduce Bottle, an egocentric RGB-D dataset of object manipulation toward specified targets, with coordinated head and hand motion under changing target visibility. Experiments on the public dataset and Bottle show that HAP achieves lower head motion prediction errors than representative baselines, supporting the value of hand driven intention and dynamic occlusion reasoning for anticipating human head motion. Code will be released at https://HAP-ego.github.io/HAP.

摘要（中文）：以自我为中心的运动预测主要集中在手和操作对象上，而对未来人体头部运动的预测相对研究不足。在操作过程中，头部既会将感知重新定向至目标以获取与任务相关的证据，也会与身体和手部运动协调配合。因此，我们提出了基于观察到手部运动和推断目标上下文的条件化未来六自由度（6-DoF）头部运动预测问题，并提出了HAP，一种手驱动的主动感知框架。HAP根据观察到的手部运动和物体几何结构推断每个目标物体的置信度，然后构建动态的预测性目标中心模态遮挡图（P-TAOG），以表示候选物体之间当前及潜在的遮挡关系。有向图与因果时序推理编码了随时间演变的目标条件感知状态，该状态与手部和头部运动历史相融合。随后，一种面向时间跨度的门控机制将学习到的轨迹与恒定速度先验相结合。我们进一步引入了Bottle数据集，这是一个以自我为中心的RGB-D数据集，记录朝指定目标进行物体操作的过程，其中头部和手部运动协调一致，且目标可见性动态变化。在公开数据集和Bottle上的实验表明，HAP在头部运动预测误差方面低于代表性基线方法，验证了手部驱动意图和动态遮挡推理在预测人体头部运动中的价值。代码将发布在 https://HAP-ego.github.io/HAP。

Authors: Yunji Feng, Junyi Ma, Guanzhong Sun, Chenyang Xu, Hesheng Wang

Indicators of resilience for autonomous control systems Other

resilience indicators critical slowing down nonlinear control systems closed-loop stability quadrotor

简要说明：本文提出基于临界减速的通用弹性指标，用于预测非线性控制系统稳定性丧失，并通过模拟机器人和真实四旋翼损坏实验验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes generic resilience indicators derived from critical slowing down to predict loss of stability in nonlinear control systems, validated on simulated robotic systems and real-world quadrotor experiments with damaged propeller blades.

Abstract: As modern societies rely more on autonomous systems to facilitate daily life, assuring their safe operation is paramount. Naturally, there are many techniques available to predict and prevent system failures. However, the safety afforded by such schemes may become misaligned with the true system, which can change in unexpected ways - from partial faults to natural wear-and-tear - that subtly degrade its stability. The implications that such subtle changes have on autonomous system stability can be observed through generic indicators of resilience derived from critical slowing down, popular for anticipating catastrophic tipping points in natural systems. Here, we show how one can systematically design these generic indicators for nonlinear control systems and show how these can reflect loss of stability though simulations of canonical robotic systems wherein their proximity to instability is manipulated directly. These results are affirmed through real-world flight experiments of a quadrotor that is nudged towards instability by progressively damaging its propeller blades. Our results show that the implications of degraded resilience on closed-loop stability are evident well before they appear, for which the indicators of resilience derived here can provide an early warning.

摘要（中文）：随着现代社会越来越依赖自主系统来便利日常生活，确保其安全运行至关重要。自然，已有许多技术可用于预测和预防系统故障。然而，这些方案所提供的安全性可能与真实系统出现偏差，因为系统可能以意想不到的方式发生变化——从部分故障到自然磨损——从而微妙地削弱其稳定性。此类微妙变化对自主系统稳定性的影响，可以通过源自临界减速的通用韧性指标来观察，这些指标在预测自然系统的灾难性临界点方面广受欢迎。在此，我们展示了如何为非线性控制系统系统地设计这些通用指标，并通过规范机器人系统的仿真（其中系统与不稳定的接近程度被直接操控）来展示这些指标如何反映稳定性的丧失。这些结果通过四旋翼飞行器的真实飞行实验得到了证实，实验中通过逐步损坏其螺旋桨叶片将其推向不稳定状态。我们的结果表明，退化韧性对闭环稳定性的影响在其显现之前就已显而易见，而本文导出的韧性指标可为此提供早期预警。

Authors: Jasper van Beers, Da-Hwi Kim, Prashant Solanki, Coen de Visser

A3P5 NEMESIS Integrated Rover Design for Environmental Reconnaissance and Robotic Sampling with Reproducible Mobility Analysis and an External Data Machine Learning Calibration Benchmark Other

rover design reproducible mobility analysis machine learning calibration environmental reconnaissance robotic sampling

简要说明：本文介绍了一种用于环境侦察和机器人采样的四轮车设计研究与评估框架，包括可复现的移动性分析和基于外部传感器数据的机器学习校准基准，但综合现场性能尚未得到验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a design study and evaluation framework for a four-wheel rover for environmental reconnaissance and robotic sampling, including a reproducible mobility analysis and a machine learning calibration benchmark using external sensor data, but the integrated field performance is not yet established.

Abstract: A3P5 NEMESIS is a four-wheel rover intended to combine remote inspection, environmental observation and lightweight manipulation within one serviceable platform. This study develops a photo-constrained geometric reconstruction, a subsystem architecture and a reproducible analytical assessment while distinguishing physical prototype evidence from proposed functions. An exploratory search retrieved 5,000 bibliographic records across ten queries, yielding 4,897 distinct DOI records and 1,212 metadata candidates; selected primary studies and technical documents informed the design. The reconstructed configuration retains the carbon-pattern enclosure, independently steered wheel assemblies, folded manipulator, inclined camera mast and side sampling equipment. A declared 24 kg scenario predicts 3.28 newton-metres of gearbox-output torque per wheel on a 20-degree grade under equal load sharing; a separate static model shows how a 2 kg forward payload reduces the geometric front-tipping bound from 38.1 degrees to 32.7 degrees. These are design screens, not measured operating limits. A public-data calibration benchmark uses 7,344 eligible hourly observations, eight sensor/environmental predictors and chronological training, validation and test partitions. Validation-selected ridge regression achieves a held-out CO root-mean-square error of 0.502 milligrams per cubic metre, with a 95% daily-block bootstrap interval of 0.435-0.569 milligrams per cubic metre. This result concerns an external sensor array and cannot establish NEMESIS accuracy. The combined analysis identifies priority measurements, proposed control interfaces and mission-specific validation requirements. The contribution is a traceable engineering design study and evaluation framework for a prototype whose integrated field performance remains to be established.

摘要（中文）：A3P5 NEMESIS是一款四轮巡视器，旨在将远程检测、环境观测与轻量化操作集成于一个可维护平台之上。本研究开发了一种受照片约束的几何重建方法、子系统架构及可复现的分析评估框架，同时将物理样机证据与拟议功能加以区分。探索性检索在十组查询条件下获取了5,000条文献记录，产生4,897条独立DOI记录和1,212条元数据候选条目；所选取的主要研究和技术文档为设计提供了依据。重建构型保留了碳纤维纹路外壳、独立转向轮组、折叠式机械臂、倾斜相机桅杆及侧面采样设备。在声明24 kg工况下，模型预测在20°坡度且载荷均匀分配条件下，每个车轮的齿轮箱输出扭矩为3.28牛顿·米；另一独立静力学模型表明，2 kg前向有效载荷会将几何前倾边界从38.1°降低至32.7°。上述数值为设计筛选参数，而非实测运行极限。公开数据校准基准采用7,344条合格的逐时观测数据、八个传感器/环境预测变量，并按时间顺序划分训练集、验证集和测试集。经验证集选择的岭回归模型在留出集上实现了CO均方根误差为0.502 mg/m³，95%日块自助法置信区间为0.435–0.569 mg/m³。该结果涉及外部传感器阵列，不能据此确定NEMESIS的精度。综合分析确定了优先测量项、拟议控制接口及任务特定验证要求。本研究的贡献在于为集成现场性能尚待验证的样机提供了一套可追溯的工程设计研究与评估框架。

Authors: Shafi Bin Sultan, Sabik Bin Sultan, Safwan Sadad

PRISM: Predictive Representation of Interaction Style and Motion for Social Robot Navigation RLRobot

social navigation latent trait inference Rank-N-Contrast transformer encoder crowd simulation

简要说明：PRISM 提出了一种社交机器人导航框架，通过使用 Rank-N-Contrast 损失的 Transformer 编码器从被动观察中推断行人的交互特征，并将这些特征纳入导航策略，以减少人群模拟中的碰撞。

TLDR: PRISM introduces a framework for social robot navigation that infers pedestrians' interaction traits from passive observations using a transformer encoder with Rank-N-Contrast loss, and incorporates these traits into the navigation policy to reduce collisions in crowd simulations.

Abstract: Humans often observe others before interacting and adjust their behavior accordingly. Robot navigation in crowds, however, often represents pedestrians mainly by observed geometric states, leaving individual differences in interaction tendencies implicit. We propose PRISM (Predictive Representation of Interaction Style and Motion), a framework that infers interaction traits from passive observations of human-human interactions. PRISM encodes human trajectories into a continuous ordinal latent space with a transformer encoder trained by Rank-N-Contrast loss, and pairs each inferred trait with a temporal-stability score supplied to the navigation policy. In randomized crowd simulations, PRISM reduces collision rates over the geometry-only baseline and yields small improvements in navigation-time and path-length metrics. These results suggest the utility of passive latent-trait inference for social navigation in dynamic crowds.

摘要（中文）：人类在互动之前往往会观察他人，并据此调整自身行为。然而，机器人在人群中导航时，通常主要通过观测到的几何状态来表征行人，从而忽略了互动倾向中的个体差异。我们提出了PRISM（预测性互动风格与运动表征）框架，该框架通过被动观察人际互动来推断互动特质。PRISM利用由Rank-N-Contrast损失训练的Transformer编码器，将人体轨迹编码为连续有序的潜在空间，并将每个推断出的特质与提供给导航策略的时间稳定性评分配对。在随机人群模拟中，PRISM相比仅基于几何基线的方案降低了碰撞率，并在导航时间和路径长度指标上取得了小幅改进。这些结果表明，被动潜在特质推断在动态人群中的社交导航中具有实用价值。

Authors: Bo-Han Chen, Hiromu Taketsugu, Norimichi Ukita

ReRadar: Robust Radar Global Localization via Rotation-Equivariant Descriptor Learning Perception3D

radar global localization rotation-equivariant place recognition pose estimation

简要说明：ReRadar 提出了一种基于旋转等变描述子和地标匹配的雷达全局定位流程，在多个数据集上实现了高召回率和跨数据集泛化能力。

TLDR: ReRadar introduces a radar global localization pipeline using rotation-equivariant descriptors and landmark-based matching to achieve robust 3-DoF pose estimation across diverse environments, demonstrating high recall and cross-dataset generalization.

Abstract: Global localization with scanning millimeter-wave radar remains challenging because place-recognition descriptors often discard spatial structure needed for accurate pose retrieval. We present ReRadar, a radar global localization pipeline that extracts rotation-equivariant intermediate features using steerable convolutional neural networks, forms rotation-invariant descriptors through group pooling and NetVLAD aggregation, and combines descriptor retrieval with landmark-based matching to estimate the robot's three-degree-of-freedom (3-DoF) pose. Across fixed database-query evaluations, ReRadar with target-dataset adaptation achieves 99.37% Recall@1 on OORD Bellmouth, 91.44% Recall@1 with 80.99% F1_max on Mulran DCC01, and 99.38% Recall@1 on falling-snow Boreas sequence. Without target-dataset data, the cross-dataset model reaches 98.07% Recall@1 on OORD, performing comparably to the evaluated state-of-the-art methods.

摘要（中文）：毫米波雷达扫描的全局定位仍然具有挑战性，因为地点识别描述符通常丢弃了精确位姿检索所需的空间结构。我们提出了ReRadar，一种雷达全局定位流程，它利用可转向卷积神经网络提取旋转等变的中间特征，通过组池化和NetVLAD聚合形成旋转不变的描述符，并将描述符检索与基于地标的匹配相结合，以估计机器人的三自由度位姿。在固定数据库-查询评估中，经过目标数据集适配的ReRadar在OORD Bellmouth上达到了99.37%的Recall@1，在Mulran DCC01上达到了91.44%的Recall@1且F1_max为80.99%，在降雪的Boreas序列上达到了99.38%的Recall@1。在没有目标数据集数据的情况下，跨数据集模型在OORD上达到了98.07%的Recall@1，与评估的最先进方法表现相当。

Authors: Duc Manh Nguyen, Truong Giang Dao, Gia Nghiem Luong, Viet Trung Hoang, Anh Quang Nguyen

PESTO: Formally Correct Registration of LiDAR Point Clouds with Limited Overlap Perception3D

LiDAR point cloud registration tetrahedra features formal correctness occlusion robustness alignment error bounds

简要说明：PESTO 提出了一种基于四面体的 LiDAR 点云配准算法，证明了最坏情况下的对齐误差界限，并在遮挡和低重叠环境中表现出竞争力，但未直接涉及具身或驾驶应用。

TLDR: PESTO introduces a tetrahedra-based formal approach to LiDAR point cloud registration, proving worst-case alignment error bounds and demonstrating competitive performance under occlusion and limited overlap, though without a direct embodied or driving application.

Abstract: In this paper we tackle the problem of aligning LiDAR point clouds also known as the point cloud registration problem. We propose a new algorithm, PESTO, that exploits tetrahedra as "universal features" for LiDAR data, i.e., features that are agnostic to the environment where the LiDAR sensors are deployed. We show empirically that PESTO is competitive with existing solutions for aligning LiDAR point clouds, especially in environments with occlusions. Moreover, we establish PESTO's formal correctness by proving worst-case bounds on the alignment error.

摘要（中文）：在本文中，我们探讨了激光雷达点云对齐问题，即点云配准问题。我们提出了一种新算法PESTO，该算法利用四面体作为激光雷达数据的“通用特征”，即与激光雷达传感器部署环境无关的特征。我们通过实验证明，PESTO在激光雷达点云对齐方面与现有解决方案相比具有竞争力，尤其是在存在遮挡的环境中。此外，我们通过证明对齐误差的最坏情况界限，确立了PESTO的形式正确性。

Geometric Shortcuts for Complex Trunk Postures: Dual-Helicity Coupling Enables Low-Dimensional Control Manipulation

soft robotics continuum robots low-dimensional control geometric shortcuts elephant trunk

简要说明：该论文提出了一种斜肌中的双螺旋耦合机制，作为生成复杂象鼻姿态的低维几何捷径，并在软体机器人原型中进行了验证，对连续体机器人控制和生物学假设具有启示意义。

TLDR: The paper proposes a dual-helicity coupling mechanism in oblique muscles as a low-dimensional geometric shortcut to generate complex elephant-like trunk postures, validated in a soft-robotic prototype, with implications for continuum robot control and biological hypotheses.

Abstract: How do elephant trunks generate complex postures without relying solely on fine segmental activation? We propose that part of this complexity arises from a low-dimensional geometric shortcut: dual-helicity coupling between opposite-handed oblique muscles. In a simplified soft-robotic prototype, varying only two geometric parameters generates a broad library of elephant-like postures, suggesting a dual-layer control architecture with implications for continuum robot design and biological hypotheses.

摘要（中文）：大象的鼻子如何在不单纯依赖精细分段激活的情况下产生复杂的姿态？我们提出，这种复杂性的一部分源于一种低维度的几何捷径：相反旋向的斜向肌之间的双螺旋耦合。在一个简化的软体机器人原型中，仅改变两个几何参数即可生成一系列广泛的大象式姿态，这表明存在一种双层控制架构，对连续体机器人设计及生物学假说具有启示意义。

Authors: Huishi Huang, Danlu Chen, Matteo Lo Preti, Jun Liu, Marcelo H. Ang, Cecilia Laschi

Online Multimodal Workload Assessment in Contact-Rich Physical Human-Robot Interaction Other

physical human-robot interaction workload assessment multimodal sensing interpretable framework admittance control

简要说明：本文提出了一种在线多模态框架，用于在接触丰富的物理人机交互中评估工作负荷，整合了力、运动学和皮肤电导率，并通过可解释的加权规则在24名参与者中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an online multimodal framework for assessing workload during contact-rich physical human-robot interaction, integrating wrench, kinematics, and skin conductance with interpretable weighting rules, and evaluates it against physiological references across 24 participants.

Abstract: Contact-rich physical human--robot interaction (pHRI) imposes time-varying demands associated with physical interaction, motor regulation, and physiological response, motivating continuous assessment of interaction workload. This paper presents an online multimodal assessment framework that integrates interaction wrench, planar tool-center-point (TCP) kinematics, and skin conductance level (SCL) into four interpretable workload-related factors. Their relative contributions are adjusted using path curvature to reflect changes in motion demand and task progression to account for gradual physiological variation over time. The framework was evaluated with 24 participants across 18 controlled combinations of temperature, acoustic noise, and illuminance under two admittance-control modes. Strict leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation used standardized pupil diameter ($\mathrm{PD}_z$) as an independent physiological reference and included comparisons with static variants and representative state-of-the-art learning-based baselines. The proposed framework achieves a cohort-mean $30\,\mathrm{s}$ block-wise Spearman correlation of $ρ_{30}=0.308$ with the physiological reference, with positive subject-level correspondence in 23 of 24 participants. Its overall performance is comparable to the state-of-the-art learning-based baseline. At the same time, our framework keeps the assessment process transparent through explicit workload-related factors and defined weighting rules, while outperforming the corresponding fixed-weight formulation. The framework also maintains consistent performance across the two tested admittance-control modes. These results support a transparent and interpretable approach to continuous interaction workload assessment in contact-rich pHRI.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的人机物理交互（pHRI）对物理交互、运动调节和生理反应提出了时变需求，从而推动了对交互负荷的持续评估。本文提出了一种在线多模态评估框架，将交互力/力矩、平面工具中心点（TCP）运动学以及皮肤电导水平（SCL）整合为四个可解释的负荷相关因子。各因子的相对贡献通过路径曲率进行调节，以反映运动需求的变化，并根据任务进展考虑随时间的渐进生理变化。该框架在两种导纳控制模式下，针对温度、噪声和照度的18种受控组合，共24名受试者进行了评估。严格的留一受试者（LOSO）评估采用标准化瞳孔直径（$\mathrm{PD}_z$）作为独立的生理参考，并与静态变体及代表性最新基于学习的基线方法进行了比较。所提框架与生理参考的队列平均$30\,\mathrm{s}$分块Spearman相关系数达到$ρ_{30}=0.308$，其中24名受试者中有23名在个体水平上表现出一致性。其整体性能与最新基于学习的基线方法相当。同时，该框架通过明确的负荷相关因子和定义的权重规则保持了评估过程的透明性，且优于相应的固定权重形式。该框架在两种测试的导纳控制模式下均保持了一致的性能。这些结果支持在接触丰富的pHRI中采用透明且可解释的方法进行连续交互负荷评估。

Authors: Yanyi Chen, Fan Yang, Min Deng

Timely Activation of Safety Filters via One-Step Reachability Expansion Other

Hamilton-Jacobi reachability safety filters discrete-time execution backward reachable tube robotic control

简要说明：本文提出了一种一步扩展的后向可达管（BRT），用于更早地激活安全过滤器，确保在离散时间控制执行下的正确性，同时使用标准的连续时间可达性求解器。

TLDR: This paper proposes a one-step expanded Backward Reachable Tube (BRT) to activate safety filters earlier, ensuring correctness under discrete-time control execution while using standard continuous-time reachability solvers.

Abstract: Least-restrictive safety filters based on Hamilton-Jacobi reachability provide strong safety guarantees by overriding a nominal controller only when the system reaches the boundary of the set of unsafe states defined as a Backward Reachable Tube (BRT). These guarantees, however, rely on the continuous-time nature of the underlying formulation. In practice, robotic systems apply control at discrete sampling intervals, which creates a mismatch where the system may jump into the unsafe BRT between updates, allowing failures that are theoretically avoidable. This work introduces a principled solution based on a one-step expanded BRT that predicts all states capable of reaching the true BRT within a single timestep. By using this expanded boundary as the activation condition for the safety filter, safety interventions occur early enough to ensure correctness under discrete-time execution. We formulate this expanded set as a modified reachability problem and compute it using standard continuous-time solvers.

摘要（中文）：基于Hamilton-Jacobi可达性的最小限制安全过滤器，通过在系统到达定义为后向可达管（BRT）的不安全状态集合边界时覆盖标称控制器，提供了强有力的安全保证。然而，这些保证依赖于底层公式的连续时间特性。在实际应用中，机器人系统以离散采样间隔施加控制，这会产生不匹配问题，即系统可能在更新间隔内跳入不安全的BRT，从而导致理论上可避免的故障。本研究提出了一种基于单步扩展BRT的原则性解决方案，该方案预测所有在单个时间步内能够到达真实BRT的状态。通过将此扩展边界用作安全过滤器的激活条件，安全干预能够及时发生，从而确保离散时间执行下的正确性。我们将此扩展集合表述为修正的可达性问题，并使用标准连续时间求解器进行计算。

Authors: Javier Borquez

RoboVAD: A Large Cross-Domain Evaluation Benchmark for Anomaly Detection in Robotic Arm Manipulation Videos Manipulation

video anomaly detection robotic arm manipulation cross-domain benchmark unseen tasks anomaly types

简要说明：RoboVAD 提出了一个用于机械臂操作视频异常检测的大规模跨域基准，其中训练时未见新任务和异常类型，并评估了包括新适应方法在内的多种先进方法。

TLDR: RoboVAD introduces a large cross-domain benchmark for video anomaly detection in robotic arm manipulation, where novel tasks and anomalies are unseen during training, and evaluates state-of-the-art methods including a novel adapted approach.

Abstract: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is an actively studied task, having wide applications in typical scenarios such as public surveillance and road traffic safety. The task is also relevant for robotic arm interactions, where it has several downstream applications, including learning better interaction and manipulation abilities, triggering recovery procedures when anomalies occur, etc. Despite its relevance, the exploration of anomaly detection in robotic arm manipulation videos is limited by the low number of available resources. To this end, we introduce RoboVAD, a large-scale benchmark for video anomaly detection that comprises challenging cross-domain evaluation scenarios, where certain actions (tasks executed by a robotic arm) and anomaly types (mistakes that occur while performing certain tasks) remain unseen during training. RoboVAD is designed to benchmark VAD methods in realistic scenarios, where robotic arms can perform unforeseen tasks, and thereby encounter new anomaly types. We train and evaluate several state-of-the-art VAD methods, including a novel method specifically adapted for robotic arm manipulation. While the proposed method outperforms many state-of-the-art competitors, all methods remain below a micro-averaged frame-level AUC threshold of 70% in the most challenging evaluation setup, confirming the difficulty of the proposed benchmark. We publicly release our dataset and code at https://zenodo.org/records/22754659.

摘要（中文）：视频异常检测（VAD）是一项活跃的研究任务，在公共监控和道路交通安全等典型场景中具有广泛应用。该任务同样与机械臂交互相关，并在此领域拥有多项下游应用，包括学习更优的交互与操作能力、在异常发生时触发恢复程序等。尽管具有相关性，但机械臂操作视频中的异常检测探索因可用资源有限而受到制约。为此，我们提出了RoboVAD，一个大规模视频异常检测基准，涵盖具有挑战性的跨域评估场景，其中某些动作（机械臂执行的任务）和异常类型（执行特定任务时发生的错误）在训练期间均未出现。RoboVAD旨在真实场景下对VAD方法进行基准测试，在这些场景中，机械臂可能执行未知任务，从而遇到新的异常类型。我们训练并评估了多种最先进的VAD方法，包括一种专门针对机械臂操作进行适配的新方法。尽管所提出的方法在性能上超越了众多最先进的竞争者，但在最具挑战性的评估设置中，所有方法的微平均帧级AUC阈值均未超过70%，这证实了所提出基准的难度。我们已在https://zenodo.org/records/22754659公开提供数据集和代码。

Authors: Alexandru-Bogdan Dura, Sebastian Balmus, Radu Tudor Ionescu

AeroWeaver: An Embodied-Agent Harness for Weaving Aerial Skills into Distributed, Adaptive Swarm Execution Other

UAV swarm LLM agents distributed coordination embodied-agent harness online adaptation

简要说明：AeroWeaver 是一个利用基于大语言模型的具身智能体来协调无人机集群的框架，通过角色条件智能体和奖励引导的在线学习，将语义任务规划与分布式、自适应的技能执行联系起来。

TLDR: AeroWeaver is a framework that uses LLM-based embodied agents to coordinate UAV swarms, connecting semantic mission planning with distributed, adaptable skill execution through role-conditioned agents and reward-guided online learning.

Abstract: Collective intelligence is a collaborative autonomy paradigm in which multiple agents pursue shared objectives through local perception, information exchange, and coordinated action. UAV swarms embody this paradigm by coordinating multiple vehicles in tasks such as search, inspection, and tracking. Recent advances in large language model (LLM) agents have strengthened natural-language task understanding and high-level planning, providing a flexible semantic interface between mission descriptions and collective behavior. While these advances expand semantic reasoning, applying LLM agents to UAV swarms raises challenges in grounding model decisions in executable capabilities, reconciling global task reasoning with distributed execution, and using mission-specific experience for continual adaptation. To address these challenges, we introduce AeroWeaver, an embodied-agent harness that weaves individual UAV skills into coordinated mission-level behavior. AeroWeaver connects semantic decisions to governed skills, organizes role-conditioned local agents for distributed coordination, and uses role-indexed state-action-reward experience to refine skill selection online. Experiments and runtime validation show that AeroWeaver maintains valid skill execution under tested conditions and supports body-local multi-UAV operation without a central agent generating joint actions from global context, while reward-guided online updates provide a training-free path for adaptive learning swarm agents from accumulated execution experience. Code: https://github.com/Admire-ljb/AeroWeaver.

摘要（中文）：集体智能是一种协作自主范式，其中多个智能体通过局部感知、信息交换和协同行动来追求共同目标。无人机蜂群通过在搜索、巡检和跟踪等任务中协调多架无人机来体现这一范式。近年来，大语言模型智能体的进展增强了自然语言任务理解和高层规划能力，为任务描述与集体行为之间提供了灵活的语义接口。尽管这些进展拓展了语义推理能力，但将大语言模型智能体应用于无人机蜂群仍面临诸多挑战，包括将模型决策落实为可执行能力、协调全局任务推理与分布式执行之间的关系，以及利用任务特定经验实现持续适应。为应对这些挑战，我们提出AeroWeaver，一种具身智能体框架，将单机无人机技能编织为协同的任务级行为。AeroWeaver将语义决策与受控技能相连接，组织基于角色条件的局部智能体以实现分布式协调，并利用角色索引的状态-动作-奖励经验在线优化技能选择。实验与运行时验证表明，AeroWeaver在测试条件下能维持有效的技能执行，并支持无中心智能体生成全局联合行动的机体本地多无人机运行，同时基于奖励引导的在线更新为蜂群智能体提供了一条免训练的、从累积执行经验中进行适应性学习的路径。代码：https://github.com/Admire-ljb/AeroWeaver。
